66378.recognize_zh: B 面板周邊血中性球呈低分葉（pseudo-Pelger）與顆粒減少的發育不良，並有成熟單核球；C 面板骨髓可見多顆單核球與前單核球（promonocyte，星號）；F 圖顯示多年持續單核球增多，綜合支持骨髓增生不良型 CMML-1，而非 ITP。
features: Panel A: a mature monocyte with folded nucleus and grey-blue vacuolated cytoplasm; no dysplasia apparent
Panel B: dysplastic neutrophils with hypolobated/pseudo-Pelger-Huet nuclei and hypogranular cytoplasm, plus a monocytoid cell (asterisk)
Panel C: marrow aspirate with monocytes and promonocytes (asterisks) showing delicate chromatin and grey-blue cytoplasm; inset shows a dysplastic megakaryocyte
Panel D: flow cytometry with increased CD34+ myeloblasts and monocytic cells showing aberrant CD56 expression
Panel E: hypercellular trephine with scattered CD34+ blasts on inset
Panel F: longitudinal graph and table documenting persistent absolute and relative monocytosis since 2018
66378.describe_en: The initial peripheral blood smear shows absolute monocytosis with morphologically mature monocytes and no dysplasia. Follow-up blood shows leukocytosis with dysplastic, hypolobated and hypogranular neutrophils and circulating monocytes. The bone marrow aspirate and biopsy are hypercellular with granulocytic and megakaryocytic dysplasia and increased blasts plus promonocytes (approximately 9%), supported by flow cytometry showing CD34+ myeloblasts and monocytes with aberrant CD56. Retrospective counts document persistent monocytosis over several years. Findings are consistent with myelodysplastic-type chronic myelomonocytic leukemia (CMML-1) evolving from clonal monocytosis.

ddx.vs: ITP shows isolated thrombocytopenia with normal leukocyte morphology and no persistent monocytosis, dysplasia or increased marrow blasts.
Reactive monocytes lack dysplasia in other lineages, lack aberrant CD56/CD2 and normal classical monocyte partitioning (>94% MO1 favors CMML), and resolve with the cause.
AML requires at least 20% blasts including promonocytes, whereas this marrow has 9%.
aCML has dysplastic neutrophilia with circulating immature granulocytes but monocytes below 10% of leukocytes.

66378.stain: Wright-Giemsa; MGG; H&E; IHC: CD34; flow

66122.recognize_zh: 臨床照片顯示雙側手掌不對稱、邊界不清的深棕色斑點至斑片，沿掌紋與掌面分布，皮膚無紅斑、脫屑或水泡；在接受免疫調節藥物（IMiD）治療的病人，符合藥物相關色素沉著。
features: Bilateral palmar hyperpigmentation with dark-brown macules coalescing into patches
Asymmetric, poorly demarcated distribution accentuating palmar creases and thenar/hypothenar areas
No erythema, scale, blistering or erosion visible
Nails show yellowish discoloration of distal tips; no obvious nail band pigmentation evident at this resolution
66122.describe_en: Clinical photograph of both palms shows asymmetric, poorly demarcated dark-brown macules and patches distributed broadly across the palmar surfaces and creases. There is no visible erythema, scaling, blistering or desquamation to suggest hand-foot syndrome or an inflammatory dermatosis. In a patient receiving an immunomodulatory drug, the appearance is consistent with drug-associated acral hyperpigmentation; this is a clinical rather than histologic diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Hand-foot syndrome presents with painful erythema, swelling and desquamation, whereas these lesions are non-erythematous and painless.
Adrenal insufficiency causes diffuse crease and mucosal pigmentation with hypotension and hyponatremia, and requires cortisol/ACTH testing to exclude.
B12 deficiency pigmentation favors knuckles and dorsal hands with macrocytic anemia, and resolves with replacement.
Morphology is similar and separation depends on drug exposure history and temporal relationship.

65930.recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結保留反應性濾泡，部分濾泡被成群大型非典型細胞（大核、明顯核仁、豐富嗜雙色性細胞質）撐大；這些細胞 MUM1 強陽性、異常表現 CD3，HHV8 與 EBER 陽性細胞都集中在濾泡內，且位於 CD21 濾泡樹突細胞網架中，這種「侷限於濾泡」的分布是認出 GLPD 的關鍵。
features: Nodal architecture preserved with reactive follicular hyperplasia at low power (A)
Occasional follicles expanded by clusters of large atypical cells with vesicular nuclei, prominent nucleoli and abundant amphophilic to plasmablastic cytoplasm, admixed with plasma cells (B, C)
Large cells show strong nuclear MUM1 and aberrant membranous CD3 (D, E)
HHV8 (nuclear) and EBV-positive cells are confined to a follicle-shaped aggregate rather than diffuse sheets (F, G)
CD21 highlights an intact follicular dendritic cell meshwork around the atypical cells (H)
65930.describe_en: Lymph node sections show preserved architecture with reactive follicular hyperplasia and interfollicular plasmacytosis. Scattered follicles are expanded by aggregates of large atypical plasmablastic cells with vesicular nuclei, prominent nucleoli and abundant amphophilic cytoplasm. The atypical cells are MUM1-positive with aberrant CD3 expression, and HHV8- and EBV-positive cells are restricted to the germinal center compartment within an intact CD21-positive follicular dendritic cell meshwork; no diffuse sheets are present. In the context of polytypic light chain staining and absent clonal immunoglobulin gene rearrangement (per case data), findings are consistent with KSHV/HHV8-positive germinotropic lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: EC-PEL also coexpresses HHV8 and EBV but forms diffuse sheets that efface the node and is B-cell clonal, whereas GLPD is confined to follicles and polyclonal.
MCD shows regressed follicles with scattered HHV8+ lambda-restricted plasmablasts in the mantle zone that are typically EBV-negative, rather than EBV+/HHV8+ plasmablasts filling germinal centers.
Plasmablastic lymphoma is EBV-positive but HHV8-negative and grows in diffuse clonal sheets.
The aberrant CD3 could suggest T-cell lymphoma, but MUM1/CD138 plasmablastic phenotype, HHV8 positivity and lack of clonal TCR rearrangement argue against it.

65930.stain: H&E; IHC: MUM1, CD3, HHV8, CD21; ISH: EBV

65738.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的漿細胞核偏位，細胞質邊緣呈紫紅至洋紅色、邊界毛躁如火焰狀（flame cell），與左下方細胞質灰藍的一般漿細胞明顯不同；背景紅血球呈錢串狀（rouleaux）堆疊，支持血清蛋白增加。
features: Plasma cell (arrow) with eccentric nucleus and cytoplasm showing magenta-red periphery with frayed flame-like borders (flame cell)
Additional plasma cells with pinkish-purple or conventional gray-blue cytoplasm and perinuclear clearing
Coarse clock-face chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Background red cells arranged in rouleaux stacks
Scattered platelets; hypocellular smear area
65738.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows several plasma cells, including a flame cell (arrow) with an eccentric nucleus and cytoplasm with a magenta-red, frayed periphery. Other plasma cells show conventional gray-blue or pinkish cytoplasm and coarse chromatin. The red cells form rouleaux, suggesting increased serum proteins. Flame cells reflect immunoglobulin accumulation in dilated rough endoplasmic reticulum and are classically associated with IgA myeloma but can be seen in other plasma cell neoplasms, MGUS and reactive plasmacytosis; they are not diagnostic by themselves, and plasma cell quantitation and clonality are required.

ddx.vs: Mott cells contain multiple discrete round pale Russell bodies, whereas flame cells have diffuse magenta peripheral cytoplasm without globules.
Thesaurocytes are large plasma cells with abundant pink-to-pale cytoplasm and a pyknotic nucleus, lacking the frayed flame-like peripheral fringe.
Reactive plasma cells have uniform gray-blue cytoplasm with a hof and occur with polytypic light chains, though flame change alone does not exclude reactivity.

exam.answer_en: Plasma cell neoplasm with flame cells — plasma cells with magenta frayed peripheral cytoplasm and background rouleaux
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指箭頭細胞問「這是什麼細胞、代表什麼」：flame cell 為免疫球蛋白堆積於擴張的 rough ER，典型聯想 IgA myeloma，但本身不具診斷性。
背景 rouleaux 代表血清蛋白（M-protein 或多株性球蛋白）上升，常伴 ESR 升高；要與 EDTA 凝集的 agglutination（不規則團塊）區分。
診斷 myeloma（IMWG）：克隆性骨髓漿細胞 ≥10% 或 plasmacytoma，加上 CRAB 或 SLiM（骨髓漿細胞 ≥60%、受累/非受累 FLC 比 ≥100、MRI >1 個局部病灶）。
克隆性確認：flow（CD38+/CD138+、CD19−、CD45−/dim、常 CD56+）或 κ/λ 輕鏈限制；FISH 應在 CD138 分選後做，t(4;14)、t(14;16)、del(17p)、1q gain 為高風險。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 Mott cell 混淆：Mott cell 細胞質內是多顆分散、圓形淡藍的 Russell bodies；flame cell 則是細胞質周邊瀰漫性洋紅色、邊緣毛躁，沒有球狀包涵體。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指細胞質周邊呈洋紅色火焰狀的漿細胞叫什麼？傳統上最常聯想哪一種 myeloma 亞型？

65674.recognize_zh: 腎臟粗針切片中，間質被密集、單一形態的小型圓核淋巴球大片取代，將腎小管推擠分開，數個腎絲球呈硬化；浸潤細胞小而一致、缺乏嗜中性球與嗜酸性球，應懷疑小淋巴球性淋巴瘤浸潤，需免疫染色確認。
features: Dense, diffuse interstitial infiltrate replacing much of the renal cortex
Monotonous small lymphocytes with round dark nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Tubules separated and compressed by the infiltrate
Several globally sclerosed glomeruli and one glomerulus with periglomerular fibrosis
Paucity of neutrophils, eosinophils, and plasma cells within the infiltrate
65674.describe_en: Core biopsy of kidney shows a dense, diffuse interstitial infiltrate of small, monotonous lymphocytes with round hyperchromatic nuclei and scant cytoplasm that expands the interstitium and separates and compresses tubules. Several glomeruli are globally sclerotic, and one shows periglomerular fibrosis. The infiltrate lacks a significant admixture of neutrophils, eosinophils, or plasma cells, and proliferation centers are not evident at this magnification. The monotonous small lymphoid infiltrate is suggestive of renal involvement by a low-grade B-cell lymphoma; immunostains (PAX5, CD5, CD23, LEF1) support involvement by CLL/SLL.

ddx.vs: Interstitial nephritis has a mixed infiltrate with eosinophils, plasma cells, and tubulitis, predominantly T cells, rather than a sheet of monotonous B cells.
Mantle cell lymphoma is also CD5-positive but is cyclin D1/SOX11-positive and CD23-negative, unlike CLL/SLL.
Marginal zone lymphoma is usually CD5-negative with monocytoid or plasmacytic differentiation.
IgG4-related disease shows storiform fibrosis with numerous IgG4-positive plasma cells rather than a pure small lymphocyte infiltrate.

65546.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中多個細胞質淡藍、帶空泡的巨噬細胞吞噬了完整的有核細胞與紅血球（箭頭），背景可見較多單核球系細胞；在 CMML 病人漸進性血球低下下出現頻繁吞噬現象，提示續發性噬血球症候群（HLH）。
features: Hypercellular BM aspirate smear with mixed hematopoietic cells
Several macrophages with abundant pale vacuolated cytoplasm containing engulfed nucleated cells (erythroid precursors/lymphocytes, neutrophils) and red cells (arrows)
Increased monocytic cells with folded nuclei and grey-blue cytoplasm in the background
Scattered granulocytic precursors and eosinophil-like granulated cells
Abundant background red cells; no obvious sheets of blasts in this field
65546.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular and shows increased monocytic cells within a mixed hematopoietic background. Multiple macrophages with abundant pale, vacuolated cytoplasm contain phagocytosed intact nucleated cells, including erythroid precursors or lymphocytes and neutrophils, as well as red cells (hemophagocytosis). Blasts are not conspicuously increased in this field. In a patient with chronic myelomonocytic leukemia and progressive cytopenias, findings are suggestive of secondary hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis, which requires correlation with clinical and laboratory HLH criteria (fever, ferritin, triglycerides, fibrinogen, soluble CD25).

ddx.dx: Reactive hemophagocytosis without HLH (e.g., post-transfusion, sepsis)
ddx.vs: Isolated marrow hemophagocytosis is nonspecific and HLH requires fulfilling clinical and laboratory criteria rather than morphology alone.

ddx.dx: Progression of CMML to AML (acute monocytic)
ddx.vs: Would show increased blasts and promonocytes (≥20%) rather than mature macrophages engulfing intact cells.
Neoplastic histiocytes are cytologically atypical with large pleomorphic nuclei and prominent nucleoli, unlike bland phagocytic macrophages.
True hemophagocytosis shows engulfed cells within a halo inside the macrophage cytoplasm in the same focal plane rather than cells lying on top.

exam.answer_en: Hemophagocytosis in CMML marrow — macrophages engulfing nucleated cells and RBCs, suggestive of secondary HLH
pearls_zh: 考法：箭頭指著巨噬細胞，問被吞物與臨床意義；答吞噬完整有核細胞與紅血球，在 CMML 病人需懷疑 secondary HLH。
HLH 評估：發燒、脾腫大、血球低下、ferritin、triglyceride、fibrinogen、soluble CD25、NK 活性（HLH-2004）；成人可用 HScore。
CMML（WHO 5th/ICC 2022）：持續 PB monocytes ≥0.5×10⁹/L 且 ≥10% WBC；blasts + promonocytes <20%。
CMML 病人血球惡化時要鑑別：疾病進展（blast 增加、AML 轉化）、感染誘發 HLH、治療毒性。
exam.pitfall_zh: CMML 骨髓本就單核球/巨噬細胞增加，吞碎屑或凋亡細胞易被過度判讀為 HLH；需見多個完整被吞有核細胞並符合臨床實驗室標準。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指巨噬細胞呈現什麼現象？還需哪些檢驗支持 secondary HLH？
quiz.a: Hemophagocytosis；ferritin、triglyceride、fibrinogen、soluble CD25（配合臨床 HLH-2004 標準）。

65418.recognize_zh: 流式細胞圖中紅色族群側向散射（SSC）偏高、CD33 強陽性、CD117 陽性、CD13 陽性，但 HLA-DR 與 CD34 陰性，細胞內 MPO 陽性、TdT 陰性，這種 CD34−/HLA-DR− 的高 SSC 骨髓系族群是 APL 的典型免疫表型。
features: Abnormal population (red) with dim-moderate CD45 and high side scatter
Bright homogeneous CD33 and CD117 positive; CD13 positive with heterogeneous intensity
HLA-DR negative and CD34 negative; CD7 negative
CD15 expression on a subset within the CD117+ gate (80.75% of events in gate B); CD64 dim on a separate subset, CD14 negative
Cytoplasmic MPO positive; cytoplasmic CD79a, cytoplasmic CD3 and TdT negative
65418.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis shows a dominant abnormal myeloid population with dim-to-moderate CD45 and high side scatter. The cells are CD33 bright, CD117 positive, CD13 positive with heterogeneous intensity and partial CD15, while negative for HLA-DR, CD34, CD7 and CD14; CD64 is dim on a subset. Intracellular staining shows myeloperoxidase positivity with negative cytoplasmic CD79a, cytoplasmic CD3 and TdT, excluding B-, T- and lymphoblastic lineage. This CD34-negative, HLA-DR-negative, high-SSC myeloid phenotype is characteristic of abnormal promyelocytes and, together with morphology, is suggestive of acute promyelocytic leukemia; PML::RARA confirmation is required.

ddx.vs: Also frequently CD34-negative and HLA-DR-negative, but usually has lower side scatter, monocytic markers more often, and lacks PML::RARA.
Normal promyelocytes are CD34-/HLA-DR- but show a synchronous CD13/CD16/CD11b maturation pattern with high CD15, rather than a homogeneous CD33-bright arrested population.
Separation is not possible by this panel alone; genetic testing for PML::RARA is decisive.

exam.answer_en: APL immunophenotype by flow — high-SSC myeloid population CD33 bright, CD117+, CD13+, CD34−, HLA-DR−, cytoplasmic MPO+
pearls_zh: 讀圖：先看 CD45 vs SSC 找異常族群（CD45 dim、SSC 高），再逐張確認 CD34 與 HLA-DR 陰性、CD33/CD117 陽性。
APL 典型表型：CD34−、HLA-DR−、CD11b−、CD33 均質強陽、CD13 異質、CD117+；CD15 多為陰性或僅部分弱表現。
與 NPM1 突變 AML 區分：兩者都可 CD34−/HLA-DR−，NPM1 AML 常有單核球分化，最終需靠 PML::RARA 與 NPM1 分子檢測。
流式只能提示、不能確診 APL；確診需 PML::RARA，且不應等報告才開始 ATRA。
微顆粒型 APL 常 CD2 陽性，可作為輔助線索。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 CD34−/HLA-DR− 高 SSC 族群當成正常成熟中顆粒球；正常成熟時 CD13/CD11b/CD16 有序變化，APL 缺 CD11b 且 CD33 均質強陽。

quiz.q: 此流式異常族群哪兩個常見的 blast／未成熟標記為陰性而提示 APL？
quiz.a: CD34 與 HLA-DR 均陰性

65162.recognize_zh: 九張嗜伊紅球的特寫：雙葉或多葉核，細胞質中橘紅色嗜伊紅顆粒明顯減少、分布不均，出現大片無顆粒區，並有許多清楚的小圓形空泡，屬於形態異常（發育不良／活化）的嗜伊紅球。
features: Eosinophils with bilobed to multilobed nuclei with coarse chromatin
Hypogranulation: reduced and unevenly distributed orange-red specific granules with granule-free cytoplasmic areas
Multiple small, discrete, clear cytoplasmic vacuoles in most cells
Some granules appear smaller or grayish, suggesting abnormal/immature granulation
Background red cells with occasional echinocytes and dacryocyte-like forms
65162.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear images show eosinophils with bilobed to multilobed nuclei and markedly abnormal cytoplasm, including patchy hypogranulation with granule-free zones and numerous small clear cytoplasmic vacuoles. Occasional cells contain smaller, grayish granules. The background red cells show scattered echinocytes. These dysmorphic eosinophils indicate eosinophil activation or dysplasia and are nonspecific; they may be seen in allergic, parasitic, drug-related or reactive states as well as in myeloid neoplasms, so correlation with the eosinophil count, clinical history and, if persistent, bone marrow and molecular evaluation is warranted.

ddx.dx: Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia (e.g., PDGFRA rearrangement) or chronic eosinophilic leukemia
ddx.vs: Neoplastic eosinophils may look identical; persistent eosinophilia with FIP1L1::PDGFRA or other tyrosine kinase fusions, or clonal cytogenetics, separates them from reactive dysmorphism.
Delayed smear preparation causes vacuolation in multiple leukocyte types together with degenerative nuclear changes, whereas activation changes occur on fresh smears.
Neutrophils have fine lilac granules, pale pink cytoplasm and usually 3-5 nuclear lobes, lacking the residual large orange-red eosinophilic granules seen here.
Basophils have large dark purple-black granules obscuring the nucleus rather than sparse orange-red granules.

65098.recognize_zh: 低倍 CD138 免疫染色中，陽性漿細胞散布於濾泡間區，呈點狀而非成片；被圈出的萎縮濾泡本身幾乎不染。需與 H&E 的萎縮生發中心及血管增生合看，才能放在 TAFRO／iMCD 的脈絡中解讀。
features: Low-power (2x) CD138 immunostain of lymph node
CD138-positive plasma cells scattered singly and in loose groups throughout interfollicular areas
No sheets or nodular aggregates of plasma cells
Multiple small CD138-negative follicles with concentric, onion-skin-like outlines
Interfollicular stroma with scattered vascular spaces
65098.describe_en: CD138 immunohistochemistry on the lymph node at low power highlights scattered plasma cells distributed diffusely through the interfollicular areas, without sheets or nodular aggregates. The small, regressed-appearing follicles are CD138 negative. Interpreting plasma cell density at this magnification is subjective; in this field the plasma cells appear moderate in number rather than sheet-like, the pattern expected in TAFRO-type idiopathic multicentric Castleman disease as opposed to the plasmacytic subtype. Light chain ISH/IHC should be reviewed to exclude a clonal plasma cell process.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell-rich (plasmacytic) idiopathic multicentric Castleman disease
ddx.vs: The plasmacytic variant shows sheets of mature plasma cells expanding the interfollicular zones with less vascular proliferation, whereas TAFRO shows fewer plasma cells with prominent hypervascularity and atrophic germinal centers.
IgG4-related disease shows dense interfollicular plasma cells with IgG4+ cells >100/HPF and IgG4/IgG ratio >40%, often with serum IgG4 elevation, rather than a TAFRO clinical picture.

ddx.dx: Nodal involvement by plasma cell neoplasm or lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma
ddx.vs: Neoplastic plasma cell proliferations show sheets of cells with kappa or lambda light-chain restriction, which is absent in reactive Castleman-type changes.

64906.recognize_zh: 視野中大多是中大型、核圓的母細胞，染色質細緻，許多細胞核的一側有一個淡染的凹陷（杯狀核，cup-like），寬度約佔核的四分之一以上，形似魚嘴，提示伴有 NPM1 或 FLT3 突變的急性骨髓性白血病。
features: Numerous medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio
Round nuclei with a pale, invaginated clear zone giving a cup-like (fish-mouth) nuclear shape
Finely dispersed chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous at this resolution
Scant to moderate pale basophilic cytoplasm without Auer rods seen
Background red cells with crenation artifact; no mature granulocytes in this field
64906.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked leukocytosis composed almost entirely of medium to large blasts. The blasts have high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, finely dispersed chromatin, and scant pale cytoplasm, and many show a prominent cup-like nuclear invagination occupying a substantial portion of the nucleus. Auer rods and granulocytic maturation are not evident in this field, and red cells show crenation artifact. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with cup-like blasts, a morphology associated with NPM1 and FLT3-ITD mutations; flow cytometry (often CD34-negative, HLA-DR-negative) and molecular testing are recommended.

ddx.vs: Microgranular APL shows bilobed or butterfly-shaped nuclei with fine granules and occasional Auer rod bundles and requires PML::RARA testing, rather than round nuclei with cup-like invaginations.
Monoblasts and promonocytes have more abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with folded or convoluted nuclei rather than a discrete clear nuclear cup.

ddx.dx: Acute lymphoblastic leukemia with nuclear clefts
ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts have scant cytoplasm and thin nuclear clefts rather than a broad cup, and flow shows TdT and lymphoid markers without MPO.
Artifactual clearing is irregular and seen in thick areas, whereas cup-like invaginations are reproducible and involve a large proportion of blasts.

exam.answer_en: AML with cup-like blasts — blasts with prominent cup-shaped (fish-mouth) nuclear invaginations, suggestive of NPM1 and/or FLT3-ITD mutation
pearls_zh: 考法：指著核一側淡染凹陷的 blast 問「這個形態提示什麼突變」；答 NPM1 mutation（常合併 FLT3-ITD）。
Flow：cup-like AML 常為 CD34−、HLA-DR−，與 APL 表型相似，所以一定要排除 PML::RARA。
NPM1 突變 AML 在 WHO 5th 屬遺傳定義型 AML，不需 blast ≥20% 門檻；ICC 2022 則以 ≥10% blast 為門檻。
預後：NPM1 突變且無 FLT3-ITD 在 ELN 2022 屬 favorable；合併 FLT3-ITD 者為 intermediate，可加 midostaurin 等 FLT3 inhibitor。
NPM1 突變可作 MRD 監測標的（qPCR），治療後 MRD 陽性提示復發風險高。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 microgranular APL：APL 為雙葉或蝴蝶狀核、可見 Auer rod 束，且會 DIC，需急查 PML::RARA；cup-like blast 則是圓核加單一大凹陷。

quiz.q: 圖中核內有杯狀淡染凹陷的 blast 最常與哪兩個基因突變相關？其典型 flow 表型中哪兩個標記常為陰性？
quiz.a: NPM1 與 FLT3-ITD；CD34 與 HLA-DR 陰性。

64778.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片鐵染色（普魯士藍）中，數顆紅血球母細胞的核周圍排列著一圈藍綠色含鐵顆粒，環繞核周至少三分之一以上，即環狀鐵粒母細胞（ring sideroblast）；影像解析度偏低，但仍可辨認這個排列方式。
features: Erythroid precursors with blue siderotic granules arranged in a perinuclear ring
Rings encircle a substantial portion (at least one third) of the nuclear circumference with five or more granules
Several ring sideroblasts in the central field
Scattered extracellular and non-ring iron granules
Pink nuclear fast red counterstain; limited resolution and focus of this image
64778.describe_en: Prussian blue-stained bone marrow aspirate smear shows several erythroid precursors with coarse blue siderotic granules arranged in a perinuclear ring around a large part of the nuclear circumference, fulfilling the morphologic definition of ring sideroblasts. Additional scattered iron granules are present in the background. The image resolution and focus limit precise quantification, which should be performed as a percentage of erythroid precursors across the smear. In a patient with a myelodysplastic neoplasm and SF3B1 mutation, findings are consistent with ring sideroblasts in MDS with SF3B1 mutation.

ddx.vs: Normal sideroblasts contain a few scattered cytoplasmic granules that do not form a perinuclear arc around one third of the nucleus.
Ring sideroblasts appear identical; young age, microcytosis, family history and absence of dysplasia or SF3B1 mutation favor a congenital cause.

ddx.dx: Acquired reversible sideroblastic anemia (alcohol, copper deficiency, zinc excess, isoniazid)
ddx.vs: Morphology is identical; history, copper and zinc levels, and resolution after removal of the cause distinguish these from MDS.
Precipitate is extracellular and randomly distributed rather than forming a ring confined to the perinuclear cytoplasm of erythroblasts.

exam.answer_en: Ring sideroblasts on Prussian blue iron stain — erythroblasts with perinuclear rings of siderotic granules
pearls_zh: 考法：鐵染色中指著核周藍綠色顆粒問定義；答 ring sideroblast：≥5 顆鐵顆粒、環繞核周 ≥1/3。
鐵沉積於 mitochondria（核周排列的原因），代表 heme 合成障礙。
WHO 5th 的 MDS with low blasts and SF3B1 mutation 以 SF3B1 突變定義；未檢測 SF3B1 時，ring sideroblast ≥15% 可作為替代條件。
Ring sideroblast 比例要以「佔所有 erythroid precursors 的百分比」計算，不是佔全部有核細胞。
低風險 MDS-SF3B1 貧血治療可考慮 luspatercept；ring sideroblast 也見於 MDS/MPN-SF3B1-T。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與正常 sideroblast 或染劑沉澱混淆：正常 sideroblast 只有少數散在顆粒、不成環；沉澱物位於細胞外、分布隨機。可逆性原因（酒精、銅缺乏、isoniazid）形態相同，需病史排除。

quiz.q: 圖中這種細胞的形態學定義為何（顆粒數與環繞範圍）？
quiz.a: Ring sideroblast：≥5 顆 siderotic granules 環繞核周 ≥1/3。

64586.recognize_zh: 箭頭指出紅血球內或取代紅血球的深染、邊緣平直的長方形/菱形棒狀結晶（HbC crystals），背景有大量靶形細胞與折疊細胞；另見少數兩端較尖的鐮刀樣細胞，需考慮 HbSC 病。
features: Dense, homogeneous, deeply staining elongated rectangular to rhomboid crystals with straight parallel edges (arrows)
Some crystals fill the red cell, others lie within a partially empty RBC membrane
Numerous target cells and folded/irregularly contracted red cells
Occasional elongated forms with tapered ends resembling sickle or boat-shaped cells
Occasional spherocytic dense cells; normal neutrophil and scattered platelets
64586.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous target cells with folded and irregularly contracted red cells. Scattered red cells contain dense, homogeneous, rectangular to rhomboid crystals with straight, parallel edges (arrows), consistent with hemoglobin C crystals. Occasional elongated forms with more tapered ends resembling sickle or boat-shaped cells are also present; the coexistence of HbC-type crystals and sickle-like forms raises the possibility of compound hemoglobin SC disease rather than homozygous HbC disease. Findings are consistent with a hemoglobin C-containing hemoglobinopathy; hemoglobin electrophoresis/HPLC is required to define the genotype.

ddx.vs: HbSC shows both HbC-like crystals and irregular 'SC' crystals with blunt or finger-like projections plus occasional sickle forms, whereas homozygous HbC lacks true sickle cells; HPLC distinguishes them.
HbSS shows many thin crescentic sickle cells with pointed ends, Howell-Jolly bodies and nucleated RBCs rather than dense rectangular crystals with many target cells.

ddx.dx: Liver disease or post-splenectomy target cells
ddx.vs: Acquired target cells are not accompanied by intraerythrocytic dense crystals.

ddx.dx: Stain precipitate or platelet overlying RBC
ddx.vs: Precipitate is refractile, irregular and lies above the focal plane, whereas HbC crystals are homogeneous, geometric and confined within the red cell membrane.

exam.answer_en: Hemoglobin C–containing hemoglobinopathy — intraerythrocytic rectangular HbC crystals with numerous target cells (sickle-like forms raise HbSC)
pearls_zh: 考法：指紅血球內邊緣平直的長方形深染結晶問「是什麼？」——答 HbC crystal；背景大量 target cell 也是 HbC 的線索。
分子：HbC 為 β-globin 第 6 位 glutamic acid 被 lysine 取代；HbS 同一位置則為 valine。
電泳判讀：alkaline electrophoresis 中 HbC 與 HbA2、HbE、HbO 同位置，需 acid（citrate agar）電泳或 HPLC 區分。
HbSC disease 較 HbCC 嚴重，易發生增殖性視網膜病變與股骨頭缺血性壞死；結晶在脫水或脾切除後較多見。
exam.pitfall_zh: 結晶易被當成染劑沉澱或重疊的血小板；HbC 結晶幾何形狀規則、均質深染且侷限在紅血球膜內，沉澱物則不規則、會反光且不在同一焦平面。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指紅血球內的長方形深染結晶是什麼？要確認基因型應做什麼檢查？
quiz.a: Hemoglobin C crystal；hemoglobin HPLC 或電泳（含 acid pH 電泳）

64458.recognize_zh: 抹片中央一顆明顯大於周圍顆粒球的單核巨大細胞，細胞質深嗜鹼性且布滿細小空泡；但細胞核與核仁被空泡遮蔽、看不清楚，單憑此圖無法確認為 Hodgkin 細胞，需搭配組織切片與免疫染色。
features: Single very large mononuclear cell, several times the diameter of adjacent neutrophils
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with numerous small clear vacuoles, most prominent at the periphery
Nuclear outline and nucleolus largely obscured by overlying vacuoles; a macronucleolus cannot be confidently identified
Background of maturing granulocytes, a small lymphocyte and a granular myeloid cell (aspirate-type smear)
Red cells show rouleaux-like stacking in thick areas
64458.describe_en: Smear shows a single very large mononuclear cell with deeply basophilic, finely vacuolated cytoplasm, set among maturing granulocytes and a small lymphocyte. The nucleus appears large but its chromatin detail and nucleoli are obscured by the overlying cytoplasmic vacuoles, so the characteristic inclusion-like macronucleolus of a Hodgkin cell cannot be confirmed on this image alone. In the appropriate clinical and histologic context this could represent a mononuclear Hodgkin cell; however, a vacuolated large cell of other lineage cannot be excluded morphologically, and correlation with biopsy and CD30/CD15/PAX5 immunostaining is recommended.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells usually occur in cohesive clusters and are cytokeratin-positive, whereas Hodgkin cells are isolated, CD30+/CD15+ with weak PAX5.
Megakaryocytes have lobulated nuclei, granular cytoplasm with platelet budding and are CD61/CD42b-positive, lacking a macronucleolus.
Burkitt cells also show deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm but are medium-sized, monotonous and numerous, rather than a single giant cell.

ddx.dx: Anaplastic large cell lymphoma hallmark cell
ddx.vs: ALCL cells have horseshoe or kidney-shaped nuclei with a paranuclear hof and are CD30+ with T-cell/ALK markers but CD15 and PAX5 negative.

64394.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央一顆遠大於周圍細胞的巨大細胞，只有一個分葉狀摺疊的大核，周圍是豐富的細顆粒狀淡紫色細胞質、外緣偏藍，這就是成熟巨核細胞（megakaryocyte）。
features: Very large cell, many times the diameter of surrounding hematopoietic cells
Single large lobulated, folded nucleus with coarse but open chromatin and no separate nuclei
Abundant finely granular pinkish-lilac cytoplasm with a bluish, slightly fringed peripheral zone
Surrounding erythroid precursors and lymphocytes; a few cells closely abutting the megakaryocyte
Background red cells forming a thick smear area
64394.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large mature megakaryocyte with a single lobulated, folded nucleus and abundant finely granular pink-lilac cytoplasm with a bluish peripheral zone, surrounded by erythroid precursors and lymphocytes. The nuclear lobation and cytoplasmic granularity are appropriate for a mature, platelet-producing megakaryocyte, without hypolobation, separated nuclear lobes or micromegakaryocytic features. Findings are consistent with a normal-appearing megakaryocyte.

ddx.vs: Osteoclasts contain multiple separate, round, uniform nuclei with fine chromatin and coarse azurophilic granules rather than a single lobulated nucleus.
Dysplastic forms are small or hypolobated with round, monolobated or widely separated nuclei, unlike the normally lobulated nucleus here.
Megakaryoblasts are much smaller with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm with blebs.

ddx.dx: Metastatic tumor cell or Reed-Sternberg-like cell
ddx.vs: Tumor cells show prominent nucleoli and cohesive clusters, and lack the granular platelet-producing cytoplasm of megakaryocytes.

exam.answer_en: Normal mature megakaryocyte — very large cell with a single lobulated nucleus and abundant finely granular platelet-producing cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：骨髓抹片辨識最大的造血細胞，常與 osteoclast 對照追問：megakaryocyte 為單一分葉相連的核，osteoclast 為多個分開的圓核。
成熟過程為 endomitosis（DNA 複製但細胞不分裂），形成多倍體（常 16N–32N）；由細胞質延伸 proplatelets 釋出血小板，受 TPO/MPL 調控。
IHC/flow 標記：CD41（GPIIb）、CD61（GPIIIa）、CD42b、von Willebrand factor，可用來找出 micromegakaryocytes。
形態異常對照：MDS 的 micromegakaryocyte 與分離核、del(5q) 的單葉小核、ET 的大型過度分葉、PMF 的深染雲朵狀核與聚集。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 osteoclast 混淆；osteoclast 含多個分離、大小一致的圓核與粗顆粒，megakaryocyte 則是單一個分葉相連的大核。

quiz.q: 此細胞以何種方式增加 DNA 含量而成為多倍體？

64138.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中數顆巨大巨核細胞，細胞質豐富粉紅，核高度分葉、摺疊成鹿角狀（staghorn），細胞質內可見嗜中性球穿入（emperiopolesis），背景為富含顆粒球的高細胞性骨髓；這種大型過度分葉巨核細胞是原發性血小板增多症（ET）的特徵。
features: Large to giant megakaryocytes with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm
Hyperlobulated, deeply folded staghorn-like nuclei with mature chromatin
Emperiopolesis: neutrophils/granulocytes within megakaryocyte cytoplasm
Megakaryocytes loosely grouped without tight clusters or bizarre hyperchromatic nuclei
Background hypercellular marrow with maturing granulocytes and erythroid precursors
64138.describe_en: H&E section of the bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with maturing granulocytic and erythroid elements and several enlarged megakaryocytes. The megakaryocytes are large to giant with abundant mature eosinophilic cytoplasm and hyperlobulated, staghorn-like nuclei, and show emperiopolesis of granulocytes. No dense clusters of atypical megakaryocytes with hyperchromatic, cloud-like nuclei are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with the megakaryocyte morphology of essential thrombocythemia in the appropriate clinical and molecular context (JAK2/CALR/MPL).

ddx.vs: Pre-PMF megakaryocytes form dense clusters with hyperchromatic, bulbous, cloud-like nuclei and abnormal N:C ratio, often with granulocytic hypercellularity.
PV shows panmyelosis with pleomorphic megakaryocytes of varying sizes rather than predominantly giant hyperlobulated forms, and elevated hemoglobin.
Reactive megakaryocytes are increased but of normal size and lobation, without giant staghorn forms.
5q- megakaryocytes are small to medium with non-lobated round nuclei, the opposite of hyperlobulation.

exam.answer_en: Essential thrombocythemia — giant mature megakaryocytes with hyperlobulated staghorn nuclei (with emperiopolesis) in marrow biopsy
pearls_zh: 考法：切片指巨大巨核細胞問核型特徵與對應 MPN；答大型成熟、過度分葉 staghorn 核，指向 ET。
WHO 5th ET 主要條件：血小板 ≥450×10⁹/L；骨髓以大型成熟過度分葉巨核細胞增生為主、無明顯顆粒球或紅血球系增生、reticulin 罕超過 grade 1；排除其他髓系腫瘤；JAK2/CALR/MPL 突變。
驅動突變頻率約 JAK2 V617F 50–60%、CALR 20–25%、MPL 約 3–5%；CALR 型血栓風險相對較低。
血小板極高（約 ≥1000×10⁹/L）可致 acquired von Willebrand syndrome，此時使用 aspirin 前應驗 vWF 活性。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤為 prefibrotic PMF：pre-PMF 巨核細胞核深染、雲朵狀且緊密群聚，常伴顆粒球增生與較高細胞密度；ET 為散在、成熟、staghorn 過度分葉核。

quiz.q: 此切片巨核細胞的核型俗稱什麼？最符合哪一種 MPN？
quiz.a: Staghorn（鹿角狀）過度分葉核；essential thrombocythemia。

64010.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中多顆大型母細胞與單核球樣細胞，核呈摺疊、腎形或有凹陷，染色質細緻、細胞質灰藍，上方一顆細胞含粗大紫紅顆粒（疑為異常嗜酸性球前驅細胞）；「單核球分化的母細胞＋異常嗜酸性球」提示 AML 合併 inv(16)。
features: Large blasts with fine, lacy chromatin and small nucleoli
Monocytoid cells with folded, reniform, or indented nuclei
Moderate grayish-blue cytoplasm, some with fine granules
One cell (top) with coarse purple-red cytoplasmic granules, suggestive of an abnormal eosinophil
No Auer rods evident; background red cells with rouleaux-like overlap and uneven staining
64010.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous large blasts and monocytoid cells with fine chromatin, small nucleoli, moderate grayish-blue cytoplasm, and folded or reniform nuclei. One cell contains coarse purple-red granules and likely represents an abnormal eosinophil, although granule detail is limited by image quality. Auer rods are not evident in this field. Findings are suggestive of acute myeloid leukemia with myelomonocytic differentiation; the presence of abnormal eosinophils raises AML with inv(16)/t(16;16) (CBFB::MYH11), which should be confirmed by cytogenetics or molecular testing.

ddx.vs: Morphology of monocytic blasts overlaps; absence of abnormal eosinophils and negative CBFB::MYH11 testing distinguish it.
CMML has fewer than 20% blasts including promonocytes with mature monocytosis, rather than predominant blasts.
Microgranular APL cells have bilobed 'butterfly' nuclei, often with Auer rod bundles, and strong MPO with PML::RARA.
Reactive monocytes have mature condensed chromatin, abundant vacuolated cytoplasm, and no blasts.

64074.recognize_zh: 組圖中 H&E（A）為密集、核質比高、染色質細緻的小到中型母細胞，IHC 顯示 CD19（B）、CD5（C）、TdT（D）陽性而 CD20（E）、CD3（F）陰性，流式 CD45 dim 母細胞群（G）同時表現 CD19 與 CD5（H）；TdT+ B 系母細胞帶異常 CD5，即 B-ALL 合併 CD5 異常表現。
features: H&E (A): dense sheet of small-to-medium blasts with round nuclei, high N:C ratio, fine chromatin, and scant cytoplasm; the necrosis described is not included in this panel
CD19 (B): strong membranous positivity in nearly all blasts
CD5 (C): membranous positivity in the blast population (aberrant for B-lineage blasts)
TdT (D): nuclear positivity in most blasts
CD20 (E) negative; CD3 (F) negative in blasts with only scattered reactive T cells
Flow cytometry: CD45-dim/low side scatter blast gate (G, green) with uniform CD19+/CD5+ coexpression (H)
64074.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (A) shows a dense infiltrate of small-to-medium blasts with round nuclear contours, high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, fine chromatin, and scant cytoplasm. Immunohistochemistry shows the blasts are positive for CD19, CD5, and TdT and negative for CD20 and CD3, with CD3 highlighting only scattered background T cells. Flow cytometry identifies a CD45-dim, low side scatter blast population that uniformly coexpresses CD19 and CD5. Findings are consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia with aberrant CD5 expression; cytogenetic and molecular studies (e.g., BCR::ABL1, KMT2A, Ph-like alterations) are needed for classification and risk stratification.

ddx.vs: Blastoid MCL is CD19+/CD5+ but is surface immunoglobulin-positive, cyclin D1/SOX11-positive, and TdT-negative, unlike these TdT+ sIg-negative blasts.
T-ALL also expresses CD5 and TdT but is cytoplasmic CD3-positive and CD19-negative.
B/T MPAL requires cytoplasmic CD3 expression in addition to B-lineage markers; CD5 alone does not assign T lineage, and CD3 is negative here.
CLL cells are mature CD19+/CD5+/CD23+ with dim sIg and TdT-negative, with clumped chromatin rather than fine blastic chromatin.

64074.stain: H&E; IHC: CD19, CD5, TdT, CD20, CD3; flow

63882.recognize_zh: 1a–1c 周邊血中的單核球細胞質灰藍、含多顆大小不一的清亮空泡（脂質），1d 肺切片經 osmium 染色可見黑色脂滴塞在肺泡微血管內；兩者合起來指向鐮刀型血紅素 SC 病危象時的骨髓壞死／脂肪栓塞症候群（fat embolism syndrome）。
features: Peripheral blood monocytes with abundant grey-blue cytoplasm and folded/indented nuclei (1a-1c)
Multiple variably sized, sharply punched-out clear cytoplasmic vacuoles consistent with lipid
Background red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis including occasional oval/elongated forms
Lung section (1d) with numerous black osmiophilic lipid droplets within alveolar capillaries and septa
Congested alveolar walls with red cells in capillaries and an adjacent vessel containing fat droplets
63882.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several monocytes containing multiple clear, round cytoplasmic vacuoles of varying size, consistent with lipid-laden monocytes; the red cells show mild poikilocytosis. A postmortem lung section processed with osmium tetroxide shows abundant black-staining lipid droplets occupying alveolar septal capillaries and small vessels. In a patient with hemoglobin SC disease in crisis, circulating lipid-laden monocytes together with pulmonary fat emboli are consistent with bone marrow necrosis complicated by fat embolism syndrome.

ddx.dx: Vacuolated monocytes from sepsis or EDTA storage artifact
ddx.vs: Toxic or storage-related vacuoles are small and uniform and not lipid on Oil Red O/osmium, whereas fat embolism produces larger lipid droplets together with a clinical picture of acute chest syndrome and marrow necrosis.
Hemophagocytes contain engulfed red cells, platelets or nucleated cells rather than empty clear lipid vacuoles.

ddx.dx: Lipid storage disease cells (e.g., Niemann-Pick foam cells)
ddx.vs: Storage-disease foam cells are typically marrow/spleen histiocytes with innumerable fine uniform vacuoles in a chronic congenital setting, not acute circulating monocytes during a sickle crisis.

ddx.dx: Acute chest syndrome due to infection or in situ sickling
ddx.vs: Pulmonary infection or sickling shows inflammatory infiltrates or sickled red cells in capillaries without abundant osmiophilic intravascular fat droplets or marrow elements.

63754.recognize_zh: 觸片（A）以小淋巴球為主，夾雜少數細胞核大、含明顯嗜酸性大核仁的非典型大細胞；切片低倍（B）淋巴結結構被瀰漫性病灶取代並有纖維化，高倍（C）在小淋巴球、組織球、漿細胞背景中散在大型核仁明顯的細胞（箭頭），這是何杰金／RS 細胞的線索。
features: Touch preparation (A): predominance of small lymphocytes with scattered larger atypical cells bearing prominent inclusion-like eosinophilic nucleoli (arrows)
Low power section (B): effaced nodal architecture with diffuse process and some background sclerosis
High power section (C): polymorphous background of small lymphocytes, histiocytes and plasma cells
Scattered large atypical mononuclear cells with vesicular nuclei and large eosinophilic nucleoli (arrows)
Occasional eosinophil in the background
63754.describe_en: Touch preparation of the lymph node (A) shows mostly small mature lymphocytes and occasional plasma cells, with scattered larger atypical cells containing prominent, inclusion-like eosinophilic nucleoli. H&E-stained sections (B) show effacement of the nodal architecture by a diffuse lympho-histiocytic process with some background sclerosis. At high power (C), the infiltrate consists of small lymphocytes, histiocytes and plasma cells with scattered large atypical mononuclear cells with vesicular chromatin and macronucleoli, resembling Hodgkin cells; classic binucleate Reed-Sternberg forms are not clearly seen in this field. Findings are suggestive of classical Hodgkin lymphoma, to be confirmed by immunohistochemistry (CD30, CD15, PAX5).

ddx.vs: Large cells in THRLBCL are strongly CD20/PAX5+ and CD30-/CD15-, in a histiocyte-rich background lacking eosinophils and plasma cells.
PTCL has atypical small-to-medium T cells with clear cytoplasm and aberrant T-cell phenotype, and any HRS-like cells are a minor B-cell component.
Viral lymphadenitis preserves architecture with immunoblasts across a spectrum of sizes and, for CMV, true viral inclusions confirmed by immunostain.
NLPHL has vaguely nodular architecture with multilobated popcorn LP cells with smaller nucleoli that are CD20+/CD30-/CD15-.

63690.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指細胞沒有核膜，染色質已濃縮成一條條分離的深紫色染色體，呈放射狀排成花環狀，周圍是含細顆粒的淡藍色細胞質，為正在分裂的細胞。
features: Large round cell with abundant pale gray-blue cytoplasm containing fine azurophilic granules
Chromatin condensed into discrete rod-like dark purple chromosomes
Chromosomes arranged radially in a rosette around a central clearing; no nuclear membrane or nucleolus
Background of maturing granulocytic precursors (myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands) and red cells
63690.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows maturing granulocytic precursors including myelocytes, metamyelocytes, and band neutrophils. The arrowed cell has abundant finely granular cytoplasm and discrete condensed chromosomes arranged in a radial rosette around a central clear zone, without a discernible nuclear membrane. This is a mitotic figure; however, the fully discrete chromosomes and rosette arrangement suggest late prophase/prometaphase or an end-on (polar) view of metaphase rather than early prophase as labeled. Findings are consistent with a normal mitotic figure in a granulocytic precursor.

ddx.vs: In a side view the chromosomes align as a linear equatorial plate rather than a radial rosette.
Anaphase shows two separate chromosome groups at opposite poles.
A promyelocyte retains an intact nuclear membrane and nucleoli, and its chromatin is not separated into discrete chromosomes.
Karyorrhexis produces smooth round dense fragments instead of filamentous chromosome arms.

63562.recognize_zh: 上排（A）箭頭所指的淡色圓形小泡重疊在漿細胞的細胞核上，是 Dutcher bodies；下排（B）同樣的圓形透亮小泡則散布在細胞質中、不壓在核上，是 Russell bodies。
features: Plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, clumped chromatin and abundant deep-blue cytoplasm
Panel A: small round pale/clear globules overlying or indenting the nucleus (Dutcher bodies), including a binucleate/multinucleate plasma cell cluster
Panel B: multiple round clear-to-pale globules distributed within the cytoplasm away from the nucleus (Russell bodies), imparting a vacuolated appearance
Some plasma cells are enlarged with irregular cytoplasmic borders
Background of normochromic red cells with a few neutrophils and a small lymphocyte
63562.describe_en: Composite of bone marrow aspirate smears (Wright-Giemsa type stain) illustrating plasma cells with immunoglobulin inclusions. In the upper panels (A), plasma cells show small round pale globules projecting over or into the nucleus, consistent with Dutcher bodies (intranuclear pseudoinclusions); one aggregate contains several plasma cell nuclei in a common cytoplasm. In the lower panels (B), plasma cells contain multiple round pale globules confined to the cytoplasm, consistent with Russell bodies. Inclusions appear pale rather than eosinophilic on this Romanowsky stain. Findings illustrate Dutcher versus Russell bodies; Dutcher bodies in particular favor a clonal plasma cell or lymphoplasmacytic neoplasm, and clonality should be confirmed by flow cytometry or light chain studies.

ddx.vs: Mott cells are packed with numerous Russell bodies that fill the cytoplasm and obscure its basophilia, whereas these cells contain scattered globules within otherwise blue cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Cytoplasmic vacuolization (e.g., toxic or drug-related vacuoles)
ddx.vs: Simple vacuoles are empty with sharp edges and lack the pale homogeneous proteinaceous content that stains PAS-positive in immunoglobulin inclusions.

Viral inclusions sit within the nucleus with a halo and marginated chromatin, whereas Dutcher bodies are cytoplasmic invaginations overlying the nucleus that are PAS-positive and immunoglobulin-positive.

exam.answer_en: Plasma cell Ig inclusions — Dutcher bodies overlying the nucleus (panel A) versus cytoplasmic Russell bodies (panel B)
pearls_zh: 考法直接：A、B 兩排各是哪種包涵體？依位置判斷：疊在核上＝Dutcher body（核內假包涵體），侷限於胞質＝Russell body。
兩者皆為堆積的免疫球蛋白、PAS 陽性；Dutcher body 是胞質 Ig 隨核膜內陷而看似位於核內。
Dutcher body 較支持克隆性（漿細胞腫瘤、LPL、MZL）；Russell body 也常見於反應性漿細胞增生。
胞質充滿多個 Russell bodies 的漿細胞稱 Mott cell（grape cell）。
見到 Ig 包涵體時可用流式或 κ/λ 評估克隆性，並檢查血清/尿液 M 蛋白與 free light chain。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常把兩者名稱弄反，或把 Russell body 當成胞質空泡；關鍵看是否重疊於核上：Dutcher 疊在核上，Russell 位於胞質且不壓核。

quiz.q: B 排漿細胞胞質內的圓形淡色小球稱為什麼？

63498.recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 下可見瀰漫片狀的大型異型淋巴樣細胞，細胞核大且為小淋巴球的數倍，染色質呈泡狀並有明顯核仁，視野中央可見有絲分裂像，沒有腺體或巢狀結構，符合瀰漫性大 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse sheets of large discohesive atypical lymphoid cells
Large round to oval nuclei, several times the size of a small lymphocyte
Vesicular chromatin with one or more distinct nucleoli
Moderate amphophilic cytoplasm with high N:C ratio
Mitotic figures and apoptotic cells present
No glandular, nested, or cohesive epithelial architecture
63498.describe_en: Sections of the ileal lesion at high power show a diffuse, sheet-like proliferation of large atypical lymphoid cells with round to oval vesicular nuclei, conspicuous nucleoli, and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm. The cells are discohesive and lack glandular or nested architecture. Mitotic figures and scattered apoptotic bodies are readily identified. Findings are consistent with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, supported by diffuse CD20 positivity.

ddx.vs: Cells are medium-sized and monotonous with multiple small nucleoli, squared-off cytoplasmic borders, and a starry-sky pattern, with MYC rearrangement and Ki-67 near 100%.
Shows cohesive nests or sheets with keratin positivity and lack of CD45/CD20 expression.
Can mimic large-cell lymphoma but shows macronucleoli, pigment in some cells, and S100/SOX10/HMB45 positivity with CD45 negativity.
Shows hallmark cells with horseshoe nuclei, strong CD30 positivity, and T-cell markers rather than CD20.

63434.recognize_zh: 兩個箭頭所指為圓形、約一顆紅血球大小的寄生蟲體，內含十餘個散在的深紫色染色質小點（merozoite），為裂殖體（schizont）；周邊血出現裂殖體且核數多，支持間日瘧（P. vivax）。
features: Two round parasitized cells (arrows) filled with approximately 12-16 discrete dark chromatin dots (merozoites)
Merozoites dispersed throughout a pale purple parasite cytoplasm that nearly fills the host cell
Host cells are about the size of or slightly larger than adjacent red cells; stippling not resolvable
Hemozoin pigment is not clearly discernible at this resolution
Background of uninfected red cells with linear fibrous/smear artifacts and a small dense cell fragment
63434.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two round parasitized cells, each nearly filled by a schizont containing approximately 12-16 discrete chromatin dots scattered in pale purple cytoplasm. The host cells are at least as large as surrounding red cells, although Schüffner stippling and pigment cannot be resolved at this image quality. Linear fibrillar artifacts are present in the background. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium vivax schizonts.

ddx.vs: P. malariae schizonts have fewer (6-12) merozoites in a neat rosette within a normal-sized or smaller red cell.
P. ovale schizonts have fewer merozoites (6-14) within an oval red cell with fimbriated margins.
Babesia shows small pleomorphic rings and tetrad (Maltese cross) forms without schizonts or hemozoin pigment.
P. knowlesi schizonts contain up to about 16 merozoites in normal-sized red cells and mimic P. malariae, so PCR is needed in endemic Southeast Asia.

exam.answer_en: Plasmodium vivax schizonts — two red-cell-sized parasites filled with about 12–16 discrete merozoites
pearls_zh: 考法：一張圖兩個裂殖體，考官問種別與鑑別；裂殖子多且散布、蟲體幾乎充滿稍增大的紅血球，支持 P. vivax。
薄片用於種別鑑定與寄生蟲血症計算，厚片用於提高偵測敏感度；兩者均應檢查。
Babesia 不形成含多個裂殖子的裂殖體，也無瘧色素；看到裂殖體即指向 Plasmodium。
P. vivax 治療：血液期依地區抗藥性選 chloroquine 或 artemisinin-based combination，加上 primaquine/tafenoquine 清除 hypnozoite（先驗 G6PD）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 P. ovale 混淆；P. ovale 裂殖子較少（約 6–14）、紅血球呈卵圓形伴鋸齒緣，P. vivax 裂殖子較多、紅血球增大但形狀較圓。

quiz.q: 圖中箭頭所指含十餘個染色質點的蟲體是什麼期別？可據此排除 Babesia 嗎？
quiz.a: Schizont（裂殖體）；可，Babesia 不形成含多個裂殖子的裂殖體

63370.recognize_zh: 光學顯微鏡下的一根頭髮，髓質中央可見大小不一、形狀不規則的深色黑色素團塊（melanin clumps）斷續排列，不是正常細小均勻分布的色素，這是 Griscelli syndrome 的毛髮表現。
features: Unstained hair shaft examined by light microscopy
Large, irregular, elongated dark melanin aggregates along the central shaft
Clumps are unevenly spaced and variable in size (small and large)
Remainder of the cortex shows sparse fine pigment
Low-magnification smartphone image; fine pigment granule detail is limited
63370.describe_en: Light microscopic examination of an unstained hair shaft shows large, irregular, unevenly distributed aggregates of melanin pigment along the central axis, admixed with smaller clumps, rather than the fine evenly dispersed granules of normal hair. Findings are consistent with the pigmentary abnormality of Griscelli syndrome, which in type 2 (RAB27A) is associated with primary hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis.

ddx.vs: Chediak-Higashi hair shows small, regularly spaced melanin granules, and giant granules are seen in blood leukocytes.
Elejalde hair shows similar large clumps but lacks immunodeficiency/HLH and has prominent neurologic disease; separation relies on genetics (MYO5A).
Normal hair has fine, evenly distributed melanin granules without large irregular aggregates.

exam.answer_en: Griscelli syndrome — hair shaft with large, irregular, unevenly distributed melanin clumps
pearls_zh: 考法：考官給毛髮顯微照問「銀灰色頭髮＋不規則大色素團」的診斷；答 Griscelli syndrome，並與 Chédiak-Higashi 對照。
分型：GS1（MYO5A，神經症狀）、GS2（RAB27A，免疫缺陷與 HLH）、GS3（MLPH，僅色素異常）。
GS2 因 cytotoxic granule 釋放缺陷導致 primary HLH，需及早評估並以 allogeneic HSCT 根治。
Chédiak-Higashi（LYST）毛髮為規則小色素顆粒，且白血球有巨大顆粒；Griscelli 白血球無巨大顆粒。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與 Chédiak-Higashi syndrome 混淆；CHS 毛髮色素為細小均勻顆粒、血片中性球有巨大溶小體顆粒，Griscelli 為大而不規則色素團且無巨大顆粒。

quiz.q: 毛髮中見大而不規則的黑色素團，哪一型 Griscelli syndrome 會合併 HLH？致病基因為何？

63306.recognize_zh: 四格周邊血液視野中的芽細胞核有一側明顯內凹、形成淡染的杯口狀凹陷（cup-like / fish-mouth nucleus），染色質細緻、胞質少，是與 NPM1 合併 FLT3-ITD 突變相關的 AML 杯狀芽細胞。
features: Medium-sized blasts with high N:C ratio and scant pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Nuclei with a prominent invagination forming a pale, cup-shaped or fish-mouth clearing occupying part of the nucleus
Finely dispersed chromatin; nucleoli not prominent
Occasional small cytoplasmic vacuoles (lower right panel)
Background red cells without significant poikilocytosis; no Auer rods seen
63306.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (four composite fields) shows circulating blasts of medium size with high N:C ratio, finely dispersed chromatin and scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm. Many blasts display a distinctive nuclear invagination producing a pale cup-like or fish-mouth indentation that spans part of the nucleus. Auer rods are not seen, and occasional blasts contain small cytoplasmic vacuoles. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with cup-like blasts, a morphology associated with CD34-negative AML carrying NPM1 and FLT3 mutations; molecular testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Microgranular APL cells have bilobed, butterfly-shaped nuclei with fine granules and bundles of Auer rods and carry PML::RARA, rather than a single cup-like invagination.
Promonocytes have folded or convoluted nuclei with more abundant grey-blue cytoplasm and fine azurophilic granules, and are NSE-positive.

ddx.dx: Reactive or neoplastic lymphocytes with cleaved nuclei
ddx.vs: Cleaved lymphoid cells have coarser chromatin and a thin notch rather than a broad pale pocket, and lack myeloid markers.

exam.answer_en: AML with cup-like (fish-mouth) blasts — prominent nuclear invagination in agranular blasts, associated with NPM1 and FLT3-ITD mutations
pearls_zh: 考法：指核凹陷的芽細胞問形態名稱與最相關的分子變化（NPM1 突變，常合併 FLT3-ITD）；典型免疫表型為 CD34−、HLA-DR−。
診斷門檻：AML with NPM1 mutation 在 WHO 5th 不需 20% 芽細胞門檻；ICC 2022 則為 ≥10%。
IHC：NPM1 突變使蛋白異常位移到細胞質，cytoplasmic NPM1 染色可作為替代標記。
預後（ELN 2022）：NPM1 突變且無 FLT3-ITD 屬 favorable；合併 FLT3-ITD 屬 intermediate；FLT3 突變者誘導化療可合併 midostaurin。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 microgranular APL：兩者皆常 CD34−/HLA-DR−，但 APL 核為雙葉蝴蝶狀並可見成束 Auer rods；APL 是急症，必須快速以 PML::RARA 排除。

quiz.q: 圖中芽細胞核的特徵形態稱為什麼？最相關的基因突變為何？
quiz.a: Cup-like / fish-mouth nucleus；NPM1 突變（常合併 FLT3-ITD）

63242.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片低倍下可見兩團緊密堆疊、深染的三維細胞團塊，與周圍造血細胞明顯不同；插圖中為散在、核偏位且形狀不規則的非造血大細胞；這種成團、外來的非造血細胞是轉移性腫瘤侵犯骨髓的線索（本例後續 IHC 為 myoD1/desmin 陽性的橫紋肌肉瘤）。
features: Large, tightly cohesive three-dimensional clusters of darkly staining cells at low power
Crowded, overlapping round-oval nuclei with nuclear molding within clusters
Inset: dyscohesive single cells with eccentric, round to pleomorphic nuclei and a rim of pale cytoplasm (plasmacytoid appearance)
Open chromatin with nucleoli suggested in the inset cells (limited resolution)
Clusters are distinct from the sparse background hematopoietic cells and red cells
63242.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at low power shows two large, tightly cohesive, three-dimensional clusters of hyperchromatic cells with crowded, overlapping nuclei, standing out from the background hematopoietic elements. The inset demonstrates dyscohesive single cells with eccentric, round-oval to irregular nuclei, open chromatin and a rim of pale cytoplasm, imparting a plasmacytoid appearance. Nuclear detail within the clusters is limited at this magnification. The findings are suggestive of marrow infiltration by a non-hematopoietic small round cell tumor; in this case immunohistochemistry (myoD1, desmin) supported metastatic rhabdomyosarcoma.

ddx.vs: Neuroblastoma forms clusters and rosettes around fibrillary neuropil in young children and is myogenin/desmin-negative but PHOX2B/synaptophysin-positive.
Ewing sarcoma cells are uniform small round cells with scant vacuolated cytoplasm, CD99/NKX2-2-positive and myogenic marker-negative, with EWSR1 rearrangement.
Plasma cells may mimic the plasmacytoid single cells of rhabdomyosarcoma but do not form cohesive clusters and are CD138-positive and desmin-negative.
Carcinoma clusters are cytokeratin-positive, often have more abundant cytoplasm, and lack myoD1/myogenin expression.

63178.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片中多顆大型母細胞，核質比高、染色質細緻，箭頭指出細胞質內細長的奧爾氏小體（Auer rod），右下角還有一條游離在細胞外的細長 Auer rod，符合 t(8;21) AML 常見的長而細的 Auer rod。
features: Large myeloblasts with high N:C ratio and moderate basophilic cytoplasm
Round to oval nuclei with finely granular chromatin; nucleoli faintly visible
Thin, elongated Auer rod within the cytoplasm of a blast (paired arrows)
Long, slender extracellular Auer rod in the background (lower right arrow)
Occasional cell with a paler perinuclear zone; a mitotic figure and maturing myeloid cell at the top of the cluster
Background red cells and pale proteinaceous material
63178.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of large myeloblasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, finely granular chromatin, faint nucleoli and moderate basophilic cytoplasm. A thin, elongated Auer rod is present within the cytoplasm of one blast, and a long slender extracellular Auer rod is seen in the background. A mitotic figure and occasional maturing myeloid cells are also present. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia; the long thin Auer rods are characteristic of AML with RUNX1::RUNX1T1, pending cytogenetic confirmation.

ddx.vs: APL shows heavily granulated promyelocytes with bilobed nuclei and multiple Auer rods in bundles (faggot cells) rather than single long thin rods in agranular blasts.
Lymphoblasts never contain Auer rods and are MPO negative.
Auer rods can occur in MDS-IB2, but it requires fewer than 20% blasts and lacks RUNX1::RUNX1T1, which defines AML regardless of blast count.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Auer rods / artifact (e.g., stain precipitate, bacteria)
ddx.vs: True Auer rods are MPO-positive azurophilic crystalline rods, whereas precipitate is irregular and bacteria are uniform bacilli of differing color.

exam.answer_en: Acute myeloid leukemia with long slender Auer rods (intracellular and extracellular) — morphology characteristic of AML with t(8;21) RUNX1::RUNX1T1
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指箭頭處細長棒狀構造問名稱（Auer rod），再問「單條、細長、兩端尖」最典型見於哪個 AML；答 t(8;21)。
遺傳：t(8;21)(q22;q22.1) RUNX1::RUNX1T1，屬 core-binding factor AML；WHO 5th 不設母細胞比例門檻，ICC 2022 需 ≥10% 母細胞。
Flow 特徵：CD34+、MPO+，常異常表現 B 細胞標記 CD19、PAX5 及 CD56；CD56 表現與較差預後相關。
ELN 2022 屬 favorable risk，鞏固治療以 high-dose cytarabine 為主；可用 RUNX1::RUNX1T1 定量 PCR 追蹤 MRD；KIT 突變常見。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 APL 混淆；APL 為雙葉核、重顆粒的前骨髓細胞並有成束 Auer rod（faggot cell），此處為圓核母細胞、單條細長 Auer rod。

quiz.q: 右下角游離在細胞外的細長棒狀構造是什麼？這種型態最典型見於哪種 AML？

63114.recognize_zh: Langerin 染色只在部分血管腔內襯細胞呈斷續、弱至中度的線狀著色，病灶內大多數細胞為陰性，沒有成片 Langerin 陽性細胞浸潤；可藉此排除 Langerhans 細胞增生，並作為 littoral cell angioma 染色組合的一部分。
features: Low-power view of anastomosing, blood-filled vascular channels of the lesion
Discontinuous, weak-to-moderate linear staining along portions of the channel lining
Most lining and stromal cells negative or only faintly stained
No sheets or clusters of positive Langerhans-type cells
Intraluminal red cells impart background tan tone
63114.describe_en: Langerin immunostain of the splenic vascular lesion shows discontinuous, weak-to-moderate linear staining along portions of the channel lining, with most cells in the lesion negative. There is no infiltrate of langerin-positive Langerhans-type cells. Interpretation is limited by the low magnification and weak intensity; the staining pattern is best regarded as part of the immunohistochemical workup of littoral cell angioma rather than evidence of Langerhans cell histiocytosis.

ddx.vs: LCH shows sheets of langerin/CD1a/S100-positive cells with grooved nuclei and eosinophils, not linear staining along vascular channels.
Hemangioma lacks histiocytic and dendritic marker expression in its flat endothelial lining.
Angiosarcoma is distinguished by atypia, mitoses and solid growth rather than by langerin staining.

63050.recognize_zh: 脾臟切片中紅髓被成片的大型巨噬細胞取代，細胞質豐富、淡粉紅且帶細纖維狀條紋，像皺摺的衛生紙（wrinkled tissue paper），核小而偏心，即 Gaucher 細胞。
features: Sheets and aggregates of large macrophages expanding the splenic red pulp (low power, A)
Abundant pale pink cytoplasm with fine fibrillary, striated 'wrinkled tissue paper' texture (high power, B)
Small, round to oval, eccentric or peripherally placed nuclei
Compressed intervening sinusoids with red cells, scattered lymphocytes and occasional eosinophils
Scattered brown hemosiderin pigment
63050.describe_en: Sections of spleen show extensive replacement of the red pulp by sheets and aggregates of large histiocytes. At high power these cells contain abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm with a fine fibrillary, wrinkled tissue-paper texture and small eccentric nuclei. Compressed sinusoids, scattered lymphocytes and hemosiderin pigment are present between the aggregates, and no atypical lymphoid infiltrate is seen. Findings are consistent with Gaucher disease; confirmation by glucocerebrosidase enzyme activity or GBA1 genotyping is recommended, as pseudo-Gaucher cells can appear in CML, myeloma and mycobacterial infection.

ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells are morphologically similar but occur with an underlying neoplasm and normal glucocerebrosidase activity.
Niemann-Pick foam cells have finely vacuolated, bubbly lipid-laden cytoplasm rather than fibrillary striations, and are sea-blue/foamy on Giemsa.
MAI histiocytes have striated cytoplasm too but are packed with acid-fast bacilli on Ziehl-Neelsen stain.
Crystal-storing histiocytes contain eosinophilic immunoglobulin crystals that are light-chain restricted in the setting of a plasma cell or B-cell neoplasm.

exam.answer_en: Gaucher disease involving spleen — red pulp expanded by sheets of Gaucher cells with fibrillary 'wrinkled tissue paper' cytoplasm and small eccentric nuclei
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指 B 圖大細胞問名稱與胞質描述（wrinkled tissue paper／crumpled silk），並要你與 Niemann-Pick 泡沫細胞比較。
遺傳：GBA1 突變致 glucocerebrosidase 缺乏，體染色體隱性；type 1 為非神經型且最常見，type 2、3 有神經侵犯。
確診：白血球 β-glucocerebrosidase 活性下降加 GBA1 基因；lyso-Gb1 可作診斷與追蹤生物標記。Gaucher 細胞 PAS、TRAP 陽性。
治療：type 1 可用酵素替代療法（如 imiglucerase）或受質減少療法 eliglustat（需 CYP2D6 基因型）；患者 MGUS／myeloma 與 Parkinson disease 風險增加。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 pseudo-Gaucher cell 當成 Gaucher disease；CML、骨髓瘤、地中海貧血與 MAI 感染可見相似細胞，需酵素活性正常與否及抗酸染色區分。

quiz.q: B 圖大細胞的胞質常用哪個比喻描述？確診需測哪個酵素？

62986.recognize_zh: 淋巴結切片低倍下可見多個由淡染、梭形至卵圓形細胞組成的結節狀聚集，外圍有纖維帶環繞，並混有小淋巴球與嗜伊紅性球；右上方擴張的淋巴竇充滿胞質淡染泡沫狀的組織球。淡染梭形細胞聚集是非典型肥大細胞浸潤的線索，需以 tryptase、CD117、CD25 確認。
features: Nodular interfollicular aggregates of pale cells with oval to spindled nuclei and moderate clear to pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Aggregates outlined by concentric fibrous bands with a whorled appearance
Admixed small lymphocytes, plasma cells and eosinophils around the aggregates
Dilated sinus (upper right) filled with histiocytes having abundant pale foamy cytoplasm
Background small lymphocytes; magnification appears lower than the 100x objective stated in the title
62986.describe_en: Lymph node section (H&E) shows interfollicular nodular aggregates of pale cells with oval to spindled nuclei and moderate pale to clear cytoplasm, surrounded by fibrous bands and admixed small lymphocytes, plasma cells and eosinophils. An adjacent dilated sinus is filled with histiocytes with abundant foamy cytoplasm. The image appears to be at lower power than the stated 100x objective, limiting individual cell detail. The findings are consistent with lymph node involvement by systemic mastocytosis with associated sinus histiocytosis; confirmation with tryptase, CD117 and CD25 immunostains and KIT D816V testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: LCH cells are sinus-based with grooved, coffee-bean nuclei and many eosinophils, and are CD1a/langerin-positive rather than tryptase/CD117-positive.
Hodgkin lymphoma shows Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells (CD30+ CD15+) in a mixed inflammatory background, not cohesive aggregates of spindled pale mast cells.
Rosai-Dorfman histiocytes are large S100-positive cells with emperipolesis in sinuses, without interfollicular spindle cell aggregates.
Granulomas are composed of epithelioid histiocytes (CD68+, tryptase-negative) with possible giant cells and necrosis rather than tryptase/CD25-positive spindle cells.

62922.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中紅血球大小不一且形狀多變，可見大量標靶細胞（target cells）、小紅血球、碎片與淚滴狀細胞，同時有數個小而深染圓核的有核紅血球（NRBC），這種嚴重異形紅血球加上周邊有核紅血球的組合符合重型乙型地中海貧血。
features: Marked anisocytosis with microcytes, normocytes, and occasional larger cells
Marked poikilocytosis with numerous target cells, fragments, teardrop and irregular forms
Several nucleated red blood cells with small, dense, round pyknotic nuclei
Hypochromic red cells with central pallor
Two segmented neutrophils and a degenerating/smudged leukocyte at right; scattered platelets
62922.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with microcytic hypochromic red cells, numerous target cells, fragmented cells, and teardrop forms. Several nucleated red blood cells with small dense nuclei are present. Two segmented neutrophils and a smudged leukocyte are seen, and platelets are adequate. The photograph is slightly out of focus, limiting assessment of fine red cell inclusions. Findings are consistent with beta-thalassemia major.

ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps heavily; hemoglobin HPLC/electrophoresis showing Hb E with absent/reduced Hb A distinguishes it.
Hb H disease has microcytosis and target cells but fewer NRBCs, and shows golf-ball inclusions on supravital (brilliant cresyl blue) stain.
IDA shows hypochromic microcytes and pencil cells but rarely NRBCs or prominent target cells, with low ferritin.
PMF shows teardrop cells with NRBCs plus immature granulocytes and giant platelets in an adult with splenomegaly and marrow fibrosis.

exam.answer_en: Beta-thalassemia major — marked microcytic hypochromic anisopoikilocytosis with target cells, fragments and circulating nucleated red cells
pearls_zh: 考法：指小而深染圓核細胞問 NRBC，再問 NRBC 對自動白血球計數的影響（假性升高，需校正）。
Hb 分析：HbA 缺乏或明顯減少、HbF 明顯升高、HbA2 可正常或升高；需在輸血前檢測或以基因檢測確認。
機轉：過多的 α-globin 沉澱於紅系前驅細胞，造成無效造血與溶血；髓外造血導致肝脾腫大與骨骼變形。
臨床：規則輸血與鐵螯合治療（deferoxamine、deferasirox、deferiprone）；luspatercept 可減少輸血需求。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為缺鐵性貧血：缺鐵少見大量 NRBC 與標靶細胞，RDW 高且 ferritin 低；地中海貧血需以 Hb 電泳與基因檢測，並與 HbE/β-thalassemia 區分。

quiz.q: 圖中小而深染圓核的細胞是什麼？會如何影響自動白血球計數？
quiz.a: Nucleated red blood cell；使白血球計數假性升高，需校正

62858.recognize_zh: 偏光顯微鏡下暗背景中有多團明亮、帶彩虹色偏光的結晶聚集，呈放射狀或玫瑰花狀排列（紅色箭頭處），這種強雙折射的放射狀結晶是骨髓草酸鈣沉積（oxalosis）的特徵。
features: Dark polarized field with multiple bright, strongly birefringent crystal aggregates
Crystals arranged in radiating rosette or sheaf-like clusters (red arrow)
Polychromatic interference colors at crystal edges
Aggregates of varying size scattered through the section, including a small round rosette
Background tissue architecture not assessable under polarization
62858.describe_en: Examination of the bone marrow trephine section under polarized light shows multiple bright, strongly birefringent crystalline aggregates arranged in radiating rosette-like clusters (arrow), with polychromatic interference colors at the edges. The aggregates vary in size and are distributed throughout the section. Tissue architecture cannot be evaluated under polarization and should be correlated with the H&E appearance. Birefringent radiating crystal rosettes within fibrotic marrow are consistent with calcium oxalate deposition (oxalosis).

ddx.vs: Urate crystals are fine needles with strong negative birefringence under a red compensator and are usually dissolved by aqueous fixation.
CPPD crystals are rhomboid with weak positive birefringence, much dimmer than the brilliant oxalate rosettes.
Foreign materials show linear fibers, plate-like talc or Maltese-cross starch patterns rather than radiating rosettes, with a history of instrumentation or injection.

62794.recognize_zh: 闌尾黏膜腺體下方被單一形態、中小型的母細胞瀰漫浸潤取代，細胞核染色質細緻、細胞質少；免疫染色CD10、CD19、TdT瀰漫陽性，Ki-67高，符合B淋巴母細胞白血病/淋巴瘤侵犯闌尾。
features: Appendiceal mucosa with preserved colonic-type crypts and a dense, diffuse monotonous infiltrate expanding the lamina propria and wall (A)
Small to medium blasts with high N:C ratio, round nuclei and fine chromatin; residual lymphoid follicle (white arrow) and infiltrating blasts (black arrow) (B)
Diffuse CD10 positivity in blasts sparing a residual follicle (C)
Diffuse CD19 (D) and nuclear TdT (E) positivity
High Ki-67 proliferation index in the infiltrate (F)
62794.describe_en: Section of appendix shows the mucosa and wall diffusely infiltrated by a monotonous population of small to medium-sized blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio and finely dispersed chromatin, separating and surrounding preserved crypts. A residual reactive lymphoid follicle is present. Immunohistochemistry shows the blasts to be diffusely positive for CD10, CD19 and TdT with a high Ki-67 proliferation index. Findings are consistent with involvement of the appendix by B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Burkitt cells are CD10+ but TdT negative with surface light chain expression, a starry-sky pattern and near-100% Ki-67, plus MYC rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Reactive lymphoid hyperplasia of the appendix
ddx.vs: Reactive hyperplasia shows polarized germinal centers with mixed small lymphocytes and lacks sheets of TdT-positive blasts.
Myeloid sarcoma expresses MPO, lysozyme, CD117 or CD33 and lacks CD19/CD10/PAX5 B-lineage markers.
Blastoid MCL is CD5+/cyclin D1+/SOX11+ and TdT negative.

62794.stain: H&E; IHC: CD10, CD19, TdT, Ki-67

62730.recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 下脂肪空泡之間的造血組織可分辨出三系：左上方核大、染色質開放並有核仁的大型細胞，成排小而深染圓核的紅血球前驅細胞，以及胞質帶嗜伊紅顆粒的骨髓系細胞，證明脂肪腫塊內含正常成熟的骨髓成分，符合骨髓脂肪瘤。
features: Mature adipocytes with thin cords and sheets of hematopoietic cells between them
Clusters of small erythroid precursors with round, dense, dark nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Granulocytic precursors with eosinophilic granular cytoplasm and indented or band-shaped nuclei
Scattered larger cells with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli (immature myeloid cells or megakaryocytic forms), upper left
Interspersed red cells and occasional vacuolated cells; no lipoblasts or pleomorphic stromal cells
62730.describe_en: High-power section of the adrenal mass shows mature adipocytes separated by cords and sheets of hematopoietic tissue. The hematopoietic component includes clusters of erythroid precursors with small dense round nuclei, granulocytic precursors with eosinophilic granular cytoplasm and indented nuclei, and scattered larger cells with vesicular chromatin and nucleoli. Maturation appears orderly without a monotonous blast population, lipoblasts or atypical stromal cells. Findings are consistent with the trilineage hematopoietic component of an adrenal myelolipoma.

ddx.vs: The hematopoietic cells are morphologically identical, so distinction relies on clinical context (marrow failure, hemoglobinopathy) and the lack of a discrete fat-predominant encapsulated adrenal mass.
Shows sheets of immature blasts effacing tissue with MPO/CD34/CD117 positivity rather than orderly maturing erythroid and granulocytic cells.
Contains atypical hyperchromatic stromal cells and lipoblasts with MDM2 amplification rather than trilineage hematopoiesis.

62666.recognize_zh: HHV8（LANA-1）染色中，陽性的大型細胞核呈棕色點狀/顆粒狀，並集中在淋巴結竇（sinus）內，周圍小淋巴球為陰性；竇內分布的 HHV8 陽性大細胞是結外型 PEL 的特徵。
features: Nuclear HHV8 (LANA-1) positivity in large cells with granular/stippled pattern
Positive cells confined to irregular sinus-like channels in a sinusoidal distribution
Background small lymphocytes of the node HHV8-negative
Positive nuclei larger than surrounding lymphocytes, variable staining intensity
Nodal parenchyma otherwise preserved in this field
62666.describe_en: HHV8 (LANA-1) immunohistochemistry of a lymph node at medium power shows large cells with granular nuclear staining arranged within sinuses, while the surrounding small lymphocytes are negative. The sinusoidal distribution of the HHV8-positive cells mirrors the pattern of nodal involvement seen on H&E. Findings confirm HHV8 infection of the neoplastic cells and are consistent with extracavitary primary effusion lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Shares a sinusoidal pattern but is HHV8-negative.
HHV8-positive plasmablasts are scattered in mantle zones around regressed follicles rather than filling sinuses.
HHV8-positive nuclei belong to spindle cells forming slit-like vascular spaces, not large lymphoid cells.

exam.answer_en: Extracavitary primary effusion lymphoma — HHV8 (LANA-1) nuclear positivity in large cells within lymph node sinuses
pearls_zh: 考法：問「棕色核點狀陽性的是什麼染色、代表什麼病毒」（HHV8/KSHV LANA-1），以及陽性細胞的分布（竇內）。
LANA-1 染色為核內斑點狀，是 HHV8 潛伏感染的標記；PEL 定義需腫瘤細胞 HHV8 陽性，多數同時 EBV（EBER）陽性。
PEL 表型：CD45+，常缺 B 細胞標記（CD20、CD79a、PAX5 陰性）與免疫球蛋白，表現 CD138、MUM1、CD30、EMA，呈 plasmablastic 表型。
Extracavitary PEL 形成實質腫塊而非只有體腔積液，常見於 HIV 感染者，預後差。
HHV8 相關疾病家族：Kaposi sarcoma、HHV8+ multicentric Castleman disease、PEL，同一病人可並存。
exam.pitfall_zh: 竇內大細胞易被當成 ALCL 或轉移癌；ALCL 與癌皆 HHV8 陰性，LANA-1 核陽性確立 PEL，並注意 PEL 也常 CD30 陽性。

quiz.q: 圖中核陽性的染色偵測哪一種病毒蛋白？陽性大細胞位於淋巴結的哪個構造？

62538.recognize_zh: 這是間期細胞核的 FISH 影像，探針為 D7S486（7q31，紅）與 CEP7（綠）；正常應各有 2 個訊號，此核只看到 1 個紅點與 1 個綠點，表示第 7 號染色體單體（monosomy 7），是兒童難治性血球低下（RCC）中需注意的異常。
features: Interphase FISH nucleus counterstained with DAPI (blue)
Probe set: D7S486 at 7q31 (red) and D7Z1 centromere 7 / CEP7 (green)
One red and one green signal (1R1G) instead of the normal 2R2G pattern
Loss of both centromeric and 7q31 signals indicates loss of an entire chromosome 7
Tiny faint red speck is background, not a true signal
62538.describe_en: Interphase FISH image using a D7S486 (7q31, red) and CEP7 (green) probe set shows a single nucleus with one red and one green signal. Concurrent loss of both the centromeric and 7q31 signals indicates monosomy 7 rather than an isolated 7q deletion, which would show two green and one red signal. A single nucleus cannot establish the clone size, which requires scoring an adequate number of nuclei against the laboratory cutoff. In the context of pediatric hypocellular marrow failure, monosomy 7 supports a diagnosis of myelodysplastic neoplasm, such as refractory cytopenia of childhood with a high risk of progression.

ddx.vs: del(7q) shows loss of the 7q31 red signal with retention of two CEP7 green signals (1R2G).
Signal overlap or a split signal can mimic loss, so monosomy 7 must be confirmed in a percentage of scored nuclei above the cutoff.
Aplastic anemia with a similar hypocellular marrow usually lacks monosomy 7, whose presence favors MDS.

62474.recognize_zh: 脾臟切面佈滿無數大小一致、約 1–3 mm 的灰白色粟粒狀小結節，均勻分布於深紅褐色紅髓中，這種瀰漫性白髓微結節外觀是脾邊緣區淋巴瘤的典型大體表現。
features: Cut surface of an enlarged spleen, slice spanning roughly 12 cm against a 10-cm metric ruler
Innumerable uniform, small (approximately 1-3 mm) tan-white miliary nodules
Nodules evenly distributed throughout the parenchyma
Intervening dark red-brown congested red pulp
No large solitary tumor masses, infarcts or necrosis evident
62474.describe_en: Gross photograph of a sectioned spleen shows a cut surface diffusely studded with innumerable, uniform, tan-white miliary nodules measuring approximately 1-3 mm, evenly distributed within dark red-brown red pulp; the slice spans roughly 12 cm by the accompanying ruler. No large discrete masses, infarcts or necrosis are seen. This diffuse micronodular white pulp pattern is characteristic of low-grade B-cell lymphoma, most typically splenic marginal zone lymphoma, and requires histology and immunophenotyping for classification.

ddx.vs: HCL produces a homogeneous, beefy red cut surface without visible nodules because it infiltrates red pulp.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma or Hodgkin lymphoma
ddx.vs: These usually form fewer, larger, irregular, sometimes necrotic masses rather than uniform miliary nodules.
Granulomas can produce miliary nodules but histology shows epithelioid granulomas, often with necrosis, instead of monotonous lymphocytes.

ddx.dx: Other low-grade lymphomas (CLL/SLL, mantle cell, follicular)
ddx.vs: These can mimic this gross pattern, so immunophenotype (CD5, CD10, cyclin D1) is required.

exam.answer_en: Splenic marginal zone lymphoma (gross) — enlarged spleen with innumerable uniform miliary tan-white white-pulp nodules
pearls_zh: 判讀大體：先看病灶分布—均勻粟粒狀小結節代表白髓擴張（SMZL、CLL、MCL、FL）；單一或少數大腫塊則要想到 DLBCL 或 Hodgkin lymphoma。
對照：HCL 與 splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma 侵犯紅髓，切面呈均勻暗紅（beefy red），看不到白色小結節。
脾切除在 SMZL 兼具診斷與治療意義；目前也常以 rituximab 為主的治療取代手術。
組織取樣時仍需做 flow 與 IHC：CD5、CD10、cyclin D1、CD103 陰性支持 SMZL，並排除其他小 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把粟粒狀結節誤認為肉芽腫性感染（如粟粒結核）：結核結節常有壞死、大小不一；SMZL 結節大小均一、無壞死，組織學為單株 B 細胞。

quiz.q: 此脾臟切面的灰白小結節對應組織學的哪個構造擴張？

62410.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 CD20 染色中，脂肪空泡之間有大片呈強烈膜性棕色陽性的小淋巴細胞，形成瀰漫間質性至片狀浸潤；大量 CD20 陽性小 B 細胞浸潤骨髓，配合形態上的漿細胞樣分化，支持淋巴漿細胞淋巴瘤（lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma）。
features: Extensive infiltrate of CD20-positive small lymphoid cells with strong membranous staining
Interstitial to confluent paratrabecular/sheet-like distribution between fat spaces
Scattered CD20-negative (blue) residual hematopoietic cells
Small cell size consistent with mature B lymphocytes
Adjacent bony trabecula at lower edge
62410.describe_en: CD20 immunostain of the bone marrow shows an extensive interstitial to confluent infiltrate of small lymphoid cells with strong membranous positivity, occupying much of the intertrabecular space between adipocytes. Only scattered CD20-negative residual hematopoietic elements are present. CD20 does not highlight the plasmacytic component, which should be assessed with CD138 and kappa/lambda stains. In conjunction with the morphology and an IgM paraprotein, the findings are consistent with marrow involvement by lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma.

ddx.vs: MZL shows a similar CD20-positive small B-cell infiltrate, so separation requires MYD88 L265P testing and clinicopathologic correlation.
CLL cells show dim CD20 and co-express CD5, CD23 and LEF1, whereas LPL is typically CD5- and CD23-negative.
MCL is CD5-positive and cyclin D1/SOX11-positive, which LPL is not.
Benign aggregates are small, well-circumscribed, non-paratrabecular and mixed with CD3-positive T cells rather than diffuse sheets of B cells.

62346.recognize_zh: CD138 免疫染色中，成群大型細胞呈強烈、完整的細胞膜陽性（像一圈圈棕色框），而左上方多核的巨核細胞與周圍小型造血細胞都是藍色陰性，顯示是漿細胞呈片狀浸潤。
features: Strong, crisp membranous CD138 staining outlining large cells in clusters and sheets
Positive cells have abundant cytoplasm and round nuclei; some show cytoplasmic granular staining
Megakaryocyte (upper left) is CD138-negative, serving as internal negative control
Background small hematopoietic cells are negative (hematoxylin counterstain)
Plasma cells constitute a large proportion of the field, forming confluent aggregates
62346.describe_en: CD138 immunohistochemistry on the bone marrow biopsy highlights numerous large plasma cells with strong membranous staining, arranged in interstitial clusters and confluent sheets. A megakaryocyte and the background hematopoietic precursors are negative. The density and sheet-like distribution of CD138-positive cells exceed that of reactive plasmacytosis. Findings support plasma cell myeloma; kappa/lambda staining or in situ hybridization is recommended to demonstrate clonality.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are scattered singly or perivascularly, small and polytypic on kappa/lambda staining, rather than forming large confluent CD138-positive sheets.
Carcinomas can also express CD138 but are cytokeratin-positive and form cohesive nests, so CD138 alone cannot exclude them.
LPL has a background of CD20-positive small lymphocytes with fewer, mature CD138-positive plasma cells, often with MYD88 L265P and IgM paraprotein.

exam.answer_en: Plasma cell myeloma — CD138 highlights sheets of membrane-positive plasma cells replacing marrow; megakaryocyte negative
pearls_zh: 考法：CD138 切片估算漿細胞比例；切片計數常高於抹片（抹片易被稀釋），骨髓 clonal plasma cells ≥10% 為 myeloma 診斷條件之一。
IMWG myeloma-defining events：CRAB，以及 SLiM（骨髓 clonal plasma cells ≥60%、involved/uninvolved FLC ratio ≥100、MRI 大於 1 個 focal lesion）。
必須證明 clonality：kappa/lambda IHC 或 ISH；流式上 myeloma 漿細胞常 CD19−、CD45 弱/陰，並可 CD56+、CD117+。
高風險 FISH（建議於 CD138 純化細胞做）：t(4;14)、t(14;16)、del(17p)/TP53、1q gain/amplification。
exam.pitfall_zh: CD138 不等於 myeloma：反應性漿細胞增多（感染、自體免疫、肝病）也 CD138+，但呈散在、polytypic；另 CD138 亦可見於部分癌細胞與 plasmablastic lymphoma。

quiz.q: 此 CD138 染色中呈膜陽性的是什麼細胞？左上方陰性的大型多核細胞為何？
quiz.a: Plasma cells（myeloma 細胞）；megakaryocyte（內部陰性對照）

62282.recognize_zh: PD-1 染色在大結節內呈許多分散、不規則的深棕色小團塊（對應被打散的生發中心中的濾泡輔助 T 細胞），下方較小濾泡內則是一個完整的密集陽性區，背景散在陽性 T 細胞。
features: Multiple discrete, irregular clusters of strongly PD-1-positive T cells scattered within the large nodule
Clusters correspond to fragmented germinal center remnants containing follicular helper T cells
Compact, dense PD-1-positive aggregate in a smaller follicle at the bottom (intact germinal center)
Weaker, diffusely scattered positive cells in the background
No definite ring-like rosettes around large cells identifiable at this magnification
62282.describe_en: PD-1 (CD279) immunohistochemistry shows numerous discrete, irregular clusters of strongly positive follicular helper T cells dispersed within the enlarged nodule, mirroring the fragmented germinal center remnants, while a smaller adjacent follicle contains a single compact PD-1-positive aggregate. Background scattered positive T cells are also present. Definite rosettes around large cells are not identified at this power. Findings are consistent with progressive transformation of germinal centers, with high-power review recommended to exclude PD-1-positive rosettes of NLPHL.

ddx.vs: In NLPHL, PD-1-positive T cells form tight rosettes around individual LP cells dispersed through the nodule, rather than clustering within fragmented germinal center remnants.
AITL shows PD-1-positive neoplastic TFH cells expanding outside follicles into the paracortex with expanded FDC meshworks and high endothelial venules, not confined to germinal center fragments.
Follicular lymphoma follicles contain PD-1-positive T cells in a more even distribution within intact CD10/BCL2-positive neoplastic follicles rather than in fragmented clusters.

62218.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片中出現一大團黏著性（cohesive）大型細胞，核重疊擠壓、染色質細緻並有明顯淡藍色核仁，細胞質帶小空泡，這種成團且非造血細胞的外觀提示轉移性癌（乳癌）。
