features: Large cohesive three-dimensional cluster of cells with nuclear crowding and overlap
Large round to oval nuclei with finely granular chromatin and prominent pale-blue nucleoli
Moderate amount of pale blue-grey cytoplasm with small vacuoles; indistinct cell borders
Cell size several times that of adjacent red cells; high N:C ratio
Background of red cells without hematopoietic cells in the field
62218.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large cohesive cluster of non-hematopoietic cells with nuclear crowding and overlap. The cells are large with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, round to oval nuclei, finely granular chromatin and prominent nucleoli, and moderate pale cytoplasm containing small vacuoles. The cohesive arrangement distinguishes them from hematopoietic elements. Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma; immunostains (e.g. cytokeratin, GATA3, ER) on the core biopsy or clot section are recommended to confirm breast origin.

ddx.vs: Osteoblasts are loosely cohesive with eccentric nuclei, a pale perinuclear hof away from the nucleus and small nucleoli, lacking the nuclear overlap and prominent nucleoli of carcinoma.
Megakaryocytic cells are singly dispersed with lobulated nuclei or cytoplasmic blebs and are CD61/CD42b positive, not cytokeratin-positive cohesive sheets.
Hematopoietic blasts are discohesive and CD45-positive, whereas true epithelial clusters with molding are CD45-negative and cytokeratin-positive.

ddx.dx: Small round blue cell tumor (e.g. neuroblastoma, rhabdomyosarcoma)
ddx.vs: These occur mainly in children, form rosettes or small-cell clusters with scant cytoplasm, and have distinct immunoprofiles (PHOX2B, myogenin).

exam.answer_en: Metastatic carcinoma (breast) in bone marrow aspirate — large cohesive cluster of non-hematopoietic cells with crowded nuclei and prominent nucleoli
pearls_zh: 考法：骨髓抹片出現「成團黏著、細胞巨大、核重疊」的細胞群，第一個要說的是非造血細胞的轉移性腫瘤，而非 blast。
IHC 配套：cytokeratin（AE1/AE3）證實上皮來源；乳癌來源用 GATA3、ER/PR、mammaglobin；lobular carcinoma 為 E-cadherin 陰性。
周邊血常見 leukoerythroblastic picture（nucleated RBC 與未成熟顆粒球）與 teardrop cells，是骨髓浸潤的線索。
抽吸片可能 dry tap 或漏掉病灶，懷疑骨髓轉移時需做 core biopsy，常伴 desmoplastic fibrosis。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把癌細胞團誤認為 blast 聚集或 megakaryocyte：blast 為單個分散、不形成三維黏著團；megakaryocyte 為單一大細胞多葉核，而非多細胞核重疊。

quiz.q: 此骨髓抹片中的黏著性大細胞團最可能是什麼？用哪一個 IHC 標記最先證實其上皮來源？

62090.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片幾乎全是大小相近、中小型的母細胞：高核質比、細胞質極少、染色質細緻均勻、核仁不明顯，看不到顆粒或 Auer 桿，並伴隨一些破碎細胞，符合急性淋巴母細胞白血病（ALL）的外觀。
features: Monotonous population of small-to-medium blasts replacing normal hematopoiesis
Very high N:C ratio with scant pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Round to slightly indented nuclei with fine to slightly condensed homogeneous chromatin
Nucleoli inconspicuous or small; no Auer rods
Several smudged/disrupted cells; background red cells, some partially out of focus
62090.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows near-total replacement by a monotonous population of small-to-medium blasts with very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios. The blasts have round to slightly indented nuclei, fine homogeneous chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and a thin rim of agranular basophilic cytoplasm; Auer rods are not seen. Scattered smudged cells are present and residual maturing myeloid and erythroid precursors are not evident in this field. Findings are consistent with acute lymphoblastic leukemia; flow cytometry confirms lineage (reported as precursor B-ALL in this case).

ddx.vs: Morphology may be identical, so MPO cytochemistry and flow cytometry (CD13/CD33/CD117 versus CD19/CD10/cytoplasmic CD79a) are required to separate them.
Hematogones show a spectrum of maturation with an orderly CD10/CD20/CD34 continuum by flow and rarely replace the entire marrow.

ddx.dx: Leukemic mantle cell or other small B-cell lymphoma (blastoid)
ddx.vs: Mature B-cell neoplasms are TdT/CD34-negative with surface light chain restriction, whereas lymphoblasts are TdT-positive and usually lack surface immunoglobulin.

exam.answer_en: B-lymphoblastic leukemia — marrow replaced by monotonous small-to-medium lymphoblasts with scant agranular cytoplasm and inconspicuous nucleoli
pearls_zh: 考法：型態只能說「急性白血病、傾向淋巴母細胞」，考官會追問確認系別：flow 顯示 TdT+、CD19+、CD10+、cCD79a+、CD22+，MPO 陰性。
兒童好預後遺傳：high hyperdiploidy 與 ETV6::RUNX1；不良：KMT2A 重排（嬰兒、CD10−）、hypodiploidy、BCR::ABL1、iAMP21、Ph-like。
BCR::ABL1 陽性（成人較常見）需合併 TKI；治療反應最重要的預後因子是 MRD（flow 或 NGS/qPCR）。
治療相關：誘導期注意 tumor lysis syndrome；須做 CNS 評估與 intrathecal 預防；asparaginase 相關胰臟炎、血栓與肝毒性常考。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 hematogones（正常 B 前驅細胞）：hematogone 染色質更緻密、數量通常不佔滿骨髓，flow 呈連續正常成熟譜系；lymphoblast 則單一表型並常有異常抗原表現。

quiz.q: 骨髓被此類高核質比、無顆粒的單調母細胞取代，確認為 B-ALL 最關鍵的 flow 標記組合為何？

61962.recognize_zh: GATA3染色中大多數腫瘤細胞核呈中等至強度不一的核陽性，少數細胞（多為基質或反應性細胞）為陰性；GATA3核陽性常見於ALK陰性ALCL（非DUSP22重排型），可作為輔助標記。
features: Nuclear GATA3 staining in the majority of cells with variable intensity
Positive nuclei are intermediate-to-large and round to oval
Interspersed negative nuclei, including spindle-shaped stromal cells
Light nonspecific cytoplasmic background staining
61962.describe_en: GATA3 immunostain shows nuclear staining of variable intensity in the majority of the intermediate-to-large tumor cells, with interspersed negative stromal and reactive cells. The diffuse nuclear expression supports a GATA3-positive phenotype, which is common in ALK-negative anaplastic large cell lymphoma lacking DUSP22 rearrangement and in the PTCL-GATA3 subgroup. Correlation with CD30, ALK and genetic studies is required.

ddx.vs: PTCL-GATA3 lacks the uniform strong CD30 and hallmark cells that define ALCL.
DUSP22-rearranged cases are characteristically GATA3-negative and cytotoxic-marker negative with LEF1 expression, and are identified by FISH.
These are GATA3-positive but keratin-positive and CD30/T-cell-marker negative with cohesive epithelial nests.

61898.recognize_zh: 撥開頭髮後，右側顳部髮際內（紅色箭頭）可見一個小的紅色結痂丘疹；在日光暴露部位出現的結痂小丘疹可見於 HV 樣淋巴增生性疾病（HVLPD），但需病理與 EBER 證實。
features: Clinical photograph of the right temporal scalp with hair parted by a gloved hand (face masked)
Tiny erythematous crusted papule within the hair-bearing scalp near the hairline (red arrow)
Lesion measures only a few millimeters; surrounding skin appears unremarkable
No visible vesicles, ulceration or varioliform scars at this resolution
61898.describe_en: Clinical photograph of the right temporal scalp, with the hair parted and the face masked, shows a tiny erythematous crusted papule near the hairline (red arrow). The surrounding skin appears unremarkable without evident vesicles, ulceration or varioliform scarring at this resolution. This appearance is nonspecific but compatible with an evolving crusted papulovesicular lesion of hydroa vacciniforme-like lymphoproliferative disorder. Confirmation requires biopsy showing an EBER-positive T- or NK-cell infiltrate.

ddx.vs: Classic HV is a self-limited childhood photodermatosis without systemic features, whereas HVLPD may persist into adulthood with systemic symptoms and high EBV DNA load.
HSV lesions show grouped vesicles with multinucleated keratinocytes and are HSV PCR positive rather than EBER positive.
Bite reactions have eosinophil-rich wedge-shaped infiltrates without EBV-infected lymphocytes.

61834.recognize_zh: PU.1 呈清楚的核染色，大多數腫瘤細胞核（圓形、腎形到不規則形）皆陽性，細胞質不著色；PU.1 是組織球/骨髓系轉錄因子，核陽性支持組織球肉瘤的組織球系分化。
features: Diffuse strong nuclear PU.1 staining in most tumor cells
Nuclei of variable size and shape, including round, reniform, and irregular forms
Unstained, abundant cytoplasm between positive nuclei
Occasional larger pleomorphic positive nuclei
Scattered negative cells and a negative vessel at lower right
61834.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for PU.1 shows diffuse, strong nuclear positivity in the majority of neoplastic cells, whose nuclei vary from round to reniform to irregular with occasional large pleomorphic forms, set in abundant unstained cytoplasm. PU.1 is a transcription factor expressed in macrophage/histiocytic and myeloid lineages (and in some B cells), and its nuclear localization is a useful lineage marker in poorly differentiated neoplasms. In the context of CD68 and CD163 co-expression and a lack of lymphoid, dendritic, and epithelial markers, findings are consistent with histiocytic sarcoma.

ddx.vs: Myeloid sarcoma is also PU.1 positive, so MPO, CD34, CD117, and lysozyme profile plus marrow status are needed to separate it from histiocytic sarcoma.
DLBCL may show weaker PU.1 but is CD20/PAX5/CD79a positive and CD163 negative.
These tumors are PU.1 negative in tumor cells and express keratin, SOX10, or mesenchymal lineage markers.

61770.recognize_zh: A 為 H&E，細胞核偏心、染色質粗、細胞質嗜酸，呈漿細胞樣；B–H 為未標示抗體的免疫組化與原位雜交組合，包含膜狀陽性、核與細胞質強陽性、細胞質紅色陽性與陰性對照等；題目所指的漿細胞腫瘤表現 T 細胞抗原需依抗體標示判讀，圖上無法逐一確認。
features: Panel A (H&E): sheet of plasmacytoid cells with eccentric round nuclei, coarse or vesicular chromatin, occasional nucleoli and moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm; some binucleate/atypical forms
Panels B and D: membranous/cytoplasmic brown staining outlining the neoplastic cells
Panel C: strong diffuse nuclear and cytoplasmic brown staining in nearly all cells
Panels E and F: paired stains with red cytoplasmic signal in E and negative cells in F, in keeping with light-chain restriction by ISH or IHC
Panels G and H: strong membranous/cytoplasmic staining (G) and weaker membranous staining (H); the antigens are not labeled in the image
61770.describe_en: The H&E section shows a sheet of atypical plasmacytoid cells with eccentric nuclei, coarse to vesicular chromatin and moderate amphophilic to eosinophilic cytoplasm. The accompanying immunostains show diffuse membranous positivity (B, D), strong nuclear and cytoplasmic positivity (C), cytoplasmic staining in one light-chain preparation with a negative counterpart (E, F), consistent with monotypic light-chain expression, and strong (G) and weak (H) membranous staining in the tumor cells. Because the antibodies are not labeled, the specific aberrant T-cell antigens (e.g. CD3, CD4, CD7 or CD56) cannot be verified directly from the figure. The findings are consistent with a clonal plasma cell neoplasm with an aberrant immunophenotype, and the T-cell marker expression should not be mistaken for a T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Cells are larger immunoblastic forms with high Ki-67, EBER positivity and often an immunocompromised host, whereas myeloma is usually EBER negative with a lower proliferation index.
Shares CD30 and loss of B-cell markers, and may express CD4 or cytotoxic markers, but lacks CD138/MUM1 with cytoplasmic light-chain restriction and shows hallmark cells.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma with plasmacytoid morphology
ddx.vs: Tumor cells are CD138 negative and lack monotypic cytoplasmic light chains, with clonal TCR rather than IG rearrangement.
Contains a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with CD20+ B-cell component and MYD88 L265P.

61706.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 H&E 中成片的漿細胞，核偏位、染色質呈車輪狀（clock-face）、細胞質豐富偏嗜雙色並可見核旁淡染區（hof），夾雜雙核與較大、核仁明顯的非典型細胞；大片漿細胞取代骨髓符合漿細胞骨髓瘤。
features: Sheets of plasma cells replacing normal hematopoiesis
Eccentric round nuclei with coarse clock-face chromatin
Abundant amphophilic to eosinophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear hof
Occasional binucleate forms and larger cells with vesicular chromatin and nucleoli
Few residual hematopoietic elements; scattered red cells
61706.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows sheets of plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, clock-face chromatin, abundant amphophilic cytoplasm, and perinuclear clearing, replacing normal hematopoiesis. Scattered binucleate and larger atypical plasma cells with more open chromatin and nucleoli are present. Residual trilineage hematopoiesis is minimal in this field. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma; CD138 and kappa/lambda immunostaining or ISH are recommended to quantify the infiltrate and confirm light-chain restriction.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are scattered, perivascular and polytypic, rather than forming sheets with atypical and binucleate forms.
LPL contains a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with a CD20-positive B-cell component and MYD88 L265P.
Metastatic tumors form cohesive clusters and are cytokeratin or S100/SOX10-positive and CD138/light-chain negative.

exam.answer_en: Plasma cell myeloma, bone marrow biopsy — sheets of plasma cells with clock-face chromatin and perinuclear hof replacing hematopoiesis
pearls_zh: 考法：指成片核偏位、車輪狀染色質的細胞問細胞種類與估計比例；切片成片取代骨髓時，即使抽吸片被稀釋，也要以切片 CD138 IHC 估算漿細胞比例。
克隆性：κ/λ IHC 或 ISH 證明輕鏈限制；腫瘤漿細胞常 CD56+、CD19−，部分 cyclin D1+（與 t(11;14) 相關）。
IMWG 診斷：克隆性骨髓漿細胞 ≥10% 或切片證實 plasmacytoma，加上 CRAB 或 SLiM 任一；骨髓漿細胞 ≥60% 即屬 SLiM 事件。
高危險細胞遺傳（CD138 分選後 FISH）：t(4;14)、t(14;16)、t(14;20)、del(17p)/TP53、1q gain/amp。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為轉移性癌或 lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma：癌細胞成巢、keratin+；LPL 以小淋巴球、淋巴漿細胞樣細胞與漿細胞混合，且為 CD20+ B 細胞並多帶 MYD88 L265P。

quiz.q: 骨髓切片中成片核偏位、車輪狀染色質、核旁淡染的細胞是什麼？要準確估算其比例應加做哪個 IHC？
quiz.a: 漿細胞（plasma cell myeloma）；CD138 IHC（再加 κ/λ 證明克隆性）。

61642.recognize_zh: Glycophorin C 染色下左側大片密集排列的大型細胞呈強烈膜染色，核圓、染色質細緻，形成大型紅血球前驅細胞群落，右側一般骨髓只有零星陽性；大型、早期紅系前驅細胞聚集是 PCM1::JAK2 腫瘤骨髓的特徵之一。
features: Large cohesive sheet of cells with strong membranous glycophorin C staining (erythroid lineage)
Positive cells are large with round nuclei, fine chromatin and occasional nucleoli, indicating early erythroid precursors
Sharp demarcation from adjacent marrow on the right with only scattered positive cells
Thin vessel/stromal band traversing the erythroid sheet
Negative background myeloid and stromal cells
61642.describe_en: Glycophorin C immunostain of the bone marrow biopsy highlights a large, cohesive sheet of erythroid precursors with strong membranous staining, sharply demarcated from the adjacent marrow in which only scattered positive cells are present. The positive cells are large with round nuclei, fine chromatin and occasional nucleoli, consistent with left-shifted, immature erythroid precursors. This confirms that the sheets of immature cells seen on H&E are of erythroid lineage rather than myeloblasts or metastatic tumor. Expanded islands of immature erythroid precursors are a characteristic finding in myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with PCM1::JAK2.

ddx.vs: PEL shows more than 80% erythroid cells with at least 30% proerythroblasts and usually complex karyotype/TP53 mutation, whereas PCM1::JAK2 neoplasms have eosinophilia and the defining fusion.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with blast sheets
ddx.vs: Myeloblast sheets are glycophorin negative and CD34/CD117/MPO positive.
Carcinoma clusters are keratin positive and glycophorin negative.
Reactive erythroid islands show orderly maturation with predominantly late normoblasts rather than large sheets of immature precursors.

61578.recognize_zh: 流式散布圖中紅色母細胞群 CD34 由弱到強陽性、CD38 均勻陽性，形成一大群 CD34+CD38+ 的前驅細胞，另有少數 CD34+CD38 弱/陰性事件；紫色成熟細胞則 CD34 陰性。支持 B 淋巴母細胞為未成熟 CD34+ 前驅表型。
features: Bivariate dot plot: CD34-PC7 (x-axis) versus CD38-ECD (y-axis), log scales
Red (blast-gated) population with CD34 expression from dim to bright (up to about 10^2)
Blasts are CD38 positive at moderate-to-bright intensity
Small tail of CD34-positive, CD38-dim/negative red events
Purple non-blast events are CD34-negative with variable CD38
61578.describe_en: This flow cytometry dot plot displays CD34 versus CD38. The gated blast population (red) expresses CD34 from dim to bright and is uniformly CD38-positive, with a small tail of CD34-positive, CD38-dim to negative events. Non-blast events (purple) are CD34-negative with variable CD38. The dominant CD34+/CD38+ population confirms an immature precursor phenotype; lineage cannot be assigned from these two markers alone, but in combination with CD19/CD10 and cytoplasmic CD79a/CD22 it supports B-lymphoblastic leukemia. Relatively dim CD38 relative to normal B-cell precursors is a useful aberrancy in B-ALL MRD analysis.

ddx.vs: Normal CD34+ B precursors express uniformly bright CD38 and form a small population, rather than an expanded population with heterogeneous CD34 and dim-CD38 subsets.
Also CD34+/CD38+, but blasts are CD13/CD33/CD117/MPO-positive and lack CD19/CD10/cCD79a.
CD34/CD38 pattern is nonspecific; MPAL requires coexpression of lineage-defining markers such as MPO or cCD3 with B-lineage markers.

61514.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞極豐富，滿佈核卵圓或有凹陷、染色質細緻的未成熟骨髓系細胞，其中很多細胞質帶亮紅色嗜酸性顆粒，另有散在成熟嗜酸性球；「母細胞增加 + 大量嗜酸性前驅細胞」在切片上提示 AML with inv(16)。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow adjacent to a bony trabecula (right)
Sheets of immature mononuclear cells with oval to indented nuclei, fine chromatin, and small nucleoli
Many cells with abundant bright eosinophilic granular cytoplasm, consistent with eosinophil precursors
Scattered mature eosinophils with bilobed nuclei
Occasional small dark erythroid precursors; megakaryocytes not evident in this field
61514.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a markedly hypercellular marrow adjacent to a bony trabecula. The marrow space is replaced by sheets of immature mononuclear cells with oval to indented nuclei, fine chromatin, and small nucleoli, admixed with numerous cells containing bright eosinophilic cytoplasmic granules and scattered mature eosinophils. Normal trilineage hematopoiesis appears reduced, and megakaryocytes are not evident in this field. The abnormal eosinophilic granules are better characterized on the aspirate smear; in combination with increased blasts, findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with inv(16)/CBFB::MYH11.

ddx.vs: t(8;21) can also show increased eosinophil precursors, so separation requires the aspirate (abnormal basophilic granules in inv(16)) and cytogenetics or molecular testing.

ddx.dx: Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with eosinophilia and tyrosine kinase fusion
ddx.vs: This entity typically shows mature eosinophilia without a blast-predominant infiltrate and carries PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1/JAK2 rearrangements.

ddx.dx: Systemic mastocytosis with associated hematologic neoplasm
ddx.vs: Systemic mastocytosis shows spindle-shaped CD117+/tryptase+ mast cell aggregates associated with eosinophils.
Reactive eosinophilia shows orderly granulocytic maturation without sheets of blasts.

61450.recognize_zh: PML/RARA 雙色雙融合（DC-DF）探針間期 FISH：兩顆細胞各見 2 個黃色融合訊號、1 紅（PML）1 綠（RARA），即典型 2F1R1G 型態，代表 der(15) 與 der(17) 各有一個融合，符合 t(15;17) 急性前骨髓細胞白血病。
features: Interphase FISH with PML (orange) and RARA (green) dual-color dual-fusion probe on DAPI-counterstained nuclei
Both nuclei show two yellow/overlapping fusion signals, one separate orange, and one separate green signal (2F1R1G)
Fusion signals represent PML-RARA on der(15) and RARA-PML on der(17); single colors represent the normal chromosomes 15 and 17
Signals are discrete with minimal background
61450.describe_en: Interphase FISH using a PML/RARA dual-color dual-fusion probe shows two nuclei, each with two fusion signals, one orange PML signal, and one green RARA signal (2F1R1G). This is the classic pattern of a balanced reciprocal translocation, with fusion signals on der(15) and der(17) and single-color signals on the normal homologs. Findings are consistent with t(15;17)(q24;q21) PML::RARA, diagnostic of acute promyelocytic leukemia when in the appropriate morphologic context. This finding warrants urgent communication because of the coagulopathy risk and the need for ATRA-based therapy.

ddx.vs: Three-way or insertional events give non-classic patterns such as 1F2R2G or 1F1R1G rather than 2F1R1G.
These lack PML-RARA fusion and require a RARA break-apart probe to detect.
Chance overlaps are single, occur in few cells, and are excluded by laboratory cutoffs, unlike reproducible two fusion signals per nucleus.

exam.answer_en: PML::RARA dual-color dual-fusion FISH, 2F1R1G pattern — t(15;17)(q24;q21), acute promyelocytic leukemia
pearls_zh: 判讀法：dual-color dual-fusion probe 正常為 2 紅 2 綠（2R2G）；典型平衡易位為 2 fusion + 1 PML + 1 RARA（2F1R1G）。
臨床急迫性：APL 一旦形態或 FISH 懷疑，應立即開始 ATRA，不等分子確認，以減少 DIC 出血性死亡。
治療：低/中風險 APL 標準為 ATRA + arsenic trioxide（ATO）；需注意 differentiation syndrome 與 QTc 延長。
FISH 數小時可出結果，適合急診確認；RT-PCR 可定出 transcript（bcr1/2/3）並作為 MRD 追蹤。
RARA 變異夥伴：ZBTB16::RARA 對 ATRA/ATO 抗性，需以 RARA break-apart probe 或分子檢查辨識。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把隨機重疊的單一黃色訊號誤判為 fusion；真正 t(15;17) 應在多數細胞重複出現 2F1R1G，單一 fusion 需考慮隨機共位或非典型/隱匿插入型重排。

quiz.q: 此 PML/RARA DC-DF FISH 中每個細胞核呈現何種訊號型態？代表哪一種白血病？
quiz.a: 2F1R1G（2 fusion、1 PML、1 RARA）；Acute promyelocytic leukemia with PML::RARA

61322.recognize_zh: 中央可見一團由數十顆紫色顆粒狀血小板聚在一起的團塊，右下方另有一小團，旁邊是正常的嗜中性球；抹片其他區域單顆血小板很少，這種血小板凝集會使自動計數偏低，造成偽性血小板低下（多與 EDTA 有關）。
features: Central large aggregate of densely packed granular platelets, with a smaller clump at lower right
Platelets within clumps are normal-sized with purple granules
Segmented neutrophil adjacent to the clump for size comparison
Few free single platelets in the surrounding field
Red cells normocytic and normochromic with overlap and some rouleaux-like stacking in thicker areas; scattered stain precipitate
61322.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large aggregate of granular platelets in the center of the field and a smaller clump at the lower right, adjacent to a normal segmented neutrophil. Free-lying single platelets are sparse elsewhere. Red cells are normocytic and normochromic without schistocytes, and scattered dark particles represent stain precipitate. Platelet clumping of this type falsely lowers the automated platelet count; findings are consistent with pseudothrombocytopenia, likely EDTA-induced, and the count should be repeated in a citrate tube with smear review.

ddx.vs: Platelets are uniformly decreased across the smear, including the feathered edge, without aggregates.
Platelets adhere in a rosette around neutrophils rather than forming free aggregates.
Platelet clumps are enmeshed in fibrin strands and often accompanied by a visible clot in the tube.

exam.answer_en: Pseudothrombocytopenia (EDTA-dependent platelet clumping) — large aggregates of platelets on the smear with few free platelets
pearls_zh: 考法：自動血球計數顯示血小板低下但病人無出血，考官指著這團紫色顆粒團塊問「這是什麼？血小板數可信嗎？」答案是血小板凝集造成的假性低下。
處置：以 sodium citrate（或 heparin）採血管重抽並立即計數，同時檢視抹片；citrate 計數需乘以稀釋校正係數。
機轉：EDTA 使血小板 GPIIb/IIIa 構形改變，暴露隱藏抗原，被自體抗體（多為 IgG/IgM）結合而凝集；屬體外現象，無臨床意義。
血小板凝集也常使自動儀器誤將團塊計為白血球，導致 WBC 假性上升，儀器常會出現 PLT clump flag。
檢查抹片時務必看羽狀邊緣（feathered edge），大團塊常被推到邊緣而在計數區看不到。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為真正血小板低下（如 ITP）而給予不必要的治療或輸注；抹片有血小板團塊、citrate 管重測正常即可區分。另需與血小板衛星現象（圍繞嗜中性球）及凝血檢體（有纖維蛋白絲）區別。

quiz.q: 病人 CBC 血小板 30×10⁹/L 但無出血，抹片如圖。下一步應如何確認真正的血小板數？
quiz.a: 改用 sodium citrate 抗凝管重新採血計數（EDTA-dependent pseudothrombocytopenia）

61258.recognize_zh: 周邊血中可見三顆漿細胞：核偏心、染色質粗塊狀，細胞質深藍並有核旁淡染區（hof）；背景紅血球像疊錢幣般串成長鏈（rouleaux）。周邊血出現循環漿細胞加上 rouleaux，是漿細胞白血病的線索。
features: Three circulating plasma cells of variable size, the largest at upper left
Eccentric round nuclei with coarse clumped chromatin; small nucleolus-like dot in some nuclei
Moderate to abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a pale perinuclear hof
Prominent red cell rouleaux forming stacked chains across the thicker area of the smear
Scattered platelets; no other leukocytes in the field
61258.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several circulating plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, coarsely clumped chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear clearing; one cell is larger than the others. The red cells show prominent rouleaux formation, reflecting increased plasma paraprotein. No blasts or other abnormal leukocytes are present in this field. An absolute plasma cell count (or plasma cells at least 5% of leukocytes) and flow cytometry with light-chain restriction are required for the diagnosis. Findings are consistent with plasma cell leukemia.

ddx.dx: Reactive plasmacytosis (e.g., infection, serum sickness, viral illness)
ddx.vs: Circulating plasma cells are few, polyclonal on flow cytometry and usually not accompanied by marked rouleaux.
Shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes with IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P rather than a population of mature plasma cells.
Have central or slightly eccentric nuclei without clock-face chromatin or a perinuclear hof, with cytoplasm hugging adjacent red cells.

ddx.dx: Rouleaux artifact in thick smear areas
ddx.vs: Artifactual stacking disappears in the thin feathered edge, whereas true rouleaux persists and correlates with high ESR and paraprotein.

exam.answer_en: Plasma cell leukemia — multiple circulating plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and perinuclear hof on a background of rouleaux
pearls_zh: 考法：指著周邊血中核偏心、胞質深藍有 hof 的細胞，問細胞名稱與背景紅血球排列 → plasma cell 與 rouleaux；兩者合起來指向 plasma cell leukemia（PCL）。
診斷門檻：IMWG 2021 將 PCL 定義下修為周邊血抹片 circulating plasma cells ≥5%（舊標準為 ≥20% 或絕對值 >2×10⁹/L），因為 ≥5% 已具同樣不良預後。
分為 primary PCL（初診即表現）與 secondary PCL（由 myeloma 進展而來，預後更差）；primary PCL 中 t(11;14) 較常見，CD56 常為陰性。
Flow 需證明 clonal plasma cells：CD38/CD138 陽性、CD45 弱或陰性、cytoplasmic κ 或 λ 單一輕鏈限制。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 reactive lymphocytes 或 reactive plasmacytosis：反應性淋巴球核居中、胞質包繞紅血球、無 hof；反應性漿細胞數量少、多株性且無明顯 rouleaux，需以 flow 輕鏈限制區分。

quiz.q: 圖中背景紅血球排成錢幣狀長鏈稱為什麼？依 IMWG 2021，周邊血漿細胞達多少比例可診斷 PCL？

61194.recognize_zh: CSF 細胞離心抹片中兩顆細胞核偏向一側、染色質粗塊狀、細胞質深藍且有小空泡，形態像漿細胞；CSF 中出現漿細胞在骨髓瘤病人代表中樞神經侵犯。
features: Two cells on a clean cytospin background, no admixed lymphocytes or red cells
Eccentric nuclei with coarse, clumped chromatin; the upper cell nucleus irregular in contour
Moderate amount of basophilic cytoplasm with small peripheral vacuoles and irregular cytoplasmic blebs
Lower cell shows a plasmacytoid configuration with an eccentric round nucleus and a paler perinuclear zone
Nucleoli not evident; cells are larger than a typical small lymphocyte
61194.describe_en: Cytospin preparation of cerebrospinal fluid shows two atypical plasmacytoid cells with eccentric nuclei, coarsely clumped chromatin and moderate basophilic cytoplasm containing small vacuoles and irregular blebs; one nucleus has an irregular contour. No other inflammatory cells are present in this field. Only two cells are shown, which limits assessment of overall cellularity. In a patient with multiple myeloma, findings are consistent with CSF involvement by plasma cell myeloma (CNS myelomatosis), ideally confirmed by flow cytometry showing clonal CD138+/CD38+ plasma cells.

ddx.dx: Reactive plasmacytoid lymphocytes (viral or inflammatory meningitis)
ddx.vs: Reactive cells appear in a mixed lymphocytic/monocytic background and are polytypic by flow cytometry.
Shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes to plasmacytoid cells with MYD88 L265P and IgM paraprotein, not a pure plasma cell population.
Monocytes have folded nuclei with fine lacy chromatin and gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm, lacking clock-face chromatin and deep basophilia.

61130.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中三顆反應性淋巴球：中間細胞核不規則、胞質淡藍含多個空泡且邊緣呈扇貝狀；右側為大型、胞質深嗜鹼並有胞質泡突（bleb）的細胞；左下為較小的漿細胞樣淋巴球。多形性的反應性淋巴球是傳染性單核球增多症的線索。
features: Large reactive lymphocytes with abundant cytoplasm and heterogeneous appearance
Center cell: irregular, lobulated nucleus with pale blue vacuolated cytoplasm and scalloped margins
Right cell: large round nucleus with moderately condensed chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm forming a cytoplasmic bleb
Lower left cell: smaller lymphocyte with more basophilic cytoplasm at the periphery
Background red cells normocytic and normochromic; one platelet present
61130.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several large reactive lymphocytes with a spectrum of morphology. One cell has an irregular, lobulated nucleus with pale blue vacuolated cytoplasm and scalloped borders, another is a large cell with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and a cytoplasmic bleb, and a third is a smaller lymphocyte with peripheral cytoplasmic basophilia. Red cells are unremarkable and blasts are not seen. The heterogeneous reactive lymphocytosis is consistent with infectious mononucleosis, supported clinically by a positive heterophile (monospot) test.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphocytic leukemia or other B-cell lymphoproliferative disorder
ddx.vs: Neoplastic lymphocytes are monotonous with uniform nuclei and clonal on flow cytometry, whereas reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous in size and cytoplasm.
Blasts have high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and nucleoli rather than abundant basophilic cytoplasm with condensed chromatin.

ddx.dx: CMV or acute HIV infection, toxoplasmosis
ddx.vs: These produce morphologically identical reactive lymphocytes and are separated only by serology or PCR (heterophile-negative).
Monocytes have grey-blue cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules and a folded nucleus with lacy chromatin, without deep peripheral basophilia.

exam.answer_en: Infectious mononucleosis — heterogeneous reactive (Downey-type) lymphocytes with abundant basophilic, scalloped cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指胞質豐富、邊緣深藍並包繞紅血球的大型淋巴球，問名稱 → reactive（atypical）lymphocyte／Downey cell；重點是同一視野細胞大小與形態多樣（heterogeneous）。
機轉：這些反應性淋巴球主要是對 EBV 感染 B 細胞反應的 CD8+ 細胞毒性 T 細胞，而非被感染的 B 細胞本身。
血清學：heterophile antibody（monospot）陽性；幼童早期常偽陰性，此時查 EBV VCA IgM、EBNA 抗體。heterophile 陰性的類似表現考慮 CMV、急性 HIV、toxoplasmosis。
臨床連結：脾腫大者數週內避免接觸性運動以防脾破裂；誤用 ampicillin/amoxicillin 常出現皮疹；可合併 cold agglutinin（anti-i）溶血與血小板低。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與 CLL 或急性白血病混淆：CLL 細胞小而一致、染色質粗塊且有 smudge cells；母細胞 N:C 比高、染色質細緻有核仁；反應性淋巴球大小形態不一、胞質豐富而深藍。

quiz.q: 圖中這類反應性淋巴球主要屬於哪一種淋巴球亞群？
quiz.a: CD8+ 細胞毒性 T 細胞（對 EBV 感染 B 細胞的反應）

61066.recognize_zh: 淡染的血片中可見少數邊緣呈直線或尖角、形似頭盔的碎裂紅血球與小型不規則碎片，但畫面主要被大量紅血球內折光性小點與皺縮紅血球（乾燥/水分假影）佔據，血小板稀少；典型頭盔細胞的數量與清晰度有限。
features: Weakly stained smear; red cells appear gray-brown with poor hemoglobin color contrast
Occasional fragmented red cells with a straight edge and horn-like projections (helmet/keratocyte-like forms) and small irregular fragments
Numerous crenated cells (echinocytes) and many red cells containing small refractile dots, consistent with drying/water artifact
Platelets are sparse in this field
No leukocytes present for evaluation; polychromasia cannot be assessed reliably at this stain quality
61066.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear is weakly stained and shows red cells with frequent crenation and abundant intracellular refractile dots attributable to drying/water artifact. A few fragmented red cells with straight cut edges and pointed projections resembling helmet cells, as well as small irregular fragments, are present, and platelets appear decreased in the field. The artifact limits quantification of schistocytes and assessment of polychromasia. In the clinical context of SLE with seizure and thrombocytopenia, the fragmented cells are compatible with microangiopathic hemolytic anemia (TTP), but a well-stained smear is needed for a reliable schistocyte count.

ddx.vs: Artifact produces refractile inclusions and crenation in many cells across the smear, whereas true schistocytes have sharp cut edges and are accompanied by thrombocytopenia and hemolysis markers.
Bite cells show a semicircular notch or peripheral blister with Heinz bodies on supravital stain rather than a straight-edged helmet shape.
DIC also yields schistocytes but with prolonged PT/aPTT and low fibrinogen, while TTP has normal coagulation and ADAMTS13 <10%.
Morphology overlaps; history of prosthetic valve and absence of thrombocytopenia favor valve-related fragmentation.

61002.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓穿刺切片中，骨小樑之間的髓腔幾乎完全被造血細胞填滿，幾乎看不到脂肪空泡，細胞量接近 100%，遠高於成人依年齡預期，即為高度細胞化骨髓（hypercellular marrow）。
features: Bone marrow core with thin, irregular bony trabeculae
Near 100% cellularity with intertrabecular spaces packed by hematopoietic cells
Near-complete absence of adipocytes
Mottled pale and dark areas suggesting sheets of myeloid cells; no discrete lymphoid aggregates or granulomas
Cytologic detail and megakaryocyte morphology not assessable at this magnification
61002.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of a bone marrow core biopsy shows a markedly hypercellular marrow (approximately 95-100% cellularity) in which the intertrabecular spaces are almost entirely replaced by hematopoietic cells with near-complete loss of fat. Bony trabeculae are thin but present. No granulomas, discrete lymphoid aggregates or cohesive metastatic nests are evident at this magnification, and cytologic detail cannot be assessed. The marked hypercellularity is consistent with a myeloproliferative process such as atypical CML in the appropriate clinical and genetic context.

ddx.vs: Also produces a packed marrow; separation requires BCR::ABL1 testing and higher-power evaluation for dwarf megakaryocytes and absence of dysgranulopoiesis.
AML shows sheets of blasts on higher power and CD34 immunostaining with >=20% blasts, rather than maturing granulocytes.
Reactive marrows show orderly maturation without dysplasia or clonal abnormalities and often have a known stimulus.
Prefibrotic PMF has clustered atypical megakaryocytes with cloud-like nuclei and JAK2/CALR/MPL mutation, evaluated at higher power.

60938.recognize_zh: 大型巨核細胞具有少數幾個分葉的細胞核（低分葉），細胞核旁的細胞質內包含一顆完整、較淡染的細胞，即嗜中性球穿越巨核細胞的 emperipolesis。
features: Large megakaryocyte with abundant pale, finely granular cytoplasm
Nucleus with few rounded lobes (hypolobulated) and condensed chromatin
Intact smaller cell with pale-staining nucleus lying within the megakaryocyte cytoplasm adjacent to the nucleus (emperipolesis)
Surrounding marrow cells: erythroid precursors, lymphocytes and granulocytes
Background out-of-focus red cells
60938.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate shows a large megakaryocyte with abundant finely granular cytoplasm and a nucleus composed of a few rounded lobes. An intact hematopoietic cell, described as a neutrophil, lies within the megakaryocyte cytoplasm adjacent to the nucleus, consistent with emperipolesis. Surrounding marrow elements appear unremarkable. Emperipolesis is a nonspecific phenomenon seen in reactive marrows and increased in myeloproliferative neoplasms (especially myelofibrosis) and stress hematopoiesis; the hypolobulated nucleus should be evaluated in context with other megakaryocytes before interpreting as dysplasia.

ddx.vs: In hemophagocytosis the engulfed cell is degraded within a macrophage, whereas in emperipolesis a viable cell passes through megakaryocyte cytoplasm intact.
Dysplastic forms are small with mono- or separated lobes, whereas this is a large megakaryocyte and emperipolesis itself is not a dysplastic feature.
An overlying cell lies in a different focal plane and distorts the cytoplasmic outline rather than sitting within a clear space inside the cytoplasm.

exam.answer_en: Emperipolesis — an intact neutrophil within megakaryocyte cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指巨核細胞內那顆完整細胞，問「吞噬還是 emperipolesis」→ emperipolesis：被包入的細胞完整存活、可自行穿越，並非被分解。
意義非特異：可見於正常或反應性骨髓；在 MPN（尤其 primary myelofibrosis）與壓力性造血時增加，被認為與纖維化相關的細胞激素釋放有關。
Gray platelet syndrome（NBEAL2）骨髓常見明顯的巨核細胞內嗜中性球 emperipolesis 並伴纖維化，可作為關聯考點。
Rosai-Dorfman disease 的組織球中亦可見 emperipolesis（淋巴球或漿細胞位於 S100+ 組織球內），是同一名詞在不同細胞的另一考法。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤為 hemophagocytosis：吞噬作用由組織球進行，被吞細胞會變性、分解；emperipolesis 發生在巨核細胞（或 Rosai-Dorfman 組織球），內部細胞型態完整。

quiz.q: 圖中巨核細胞細胞質內含有一顆完整的嗜中性球，此現象稱為什麼？它與 hemophagocytosis 的關鍵差異是什麼？
quiz.a: Emperipolesis；被包入的細胞完整存活未被分解，且發生在巨核細胞而非組織球吞噬

60874.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中大片由核大、胞質淡染至透明、細胞間界限清楚的大型異型細胞形成片狀浸潤，占據骨小樑間大部分空間，其間夾雜少數嗜酸性球與紅系前驅細胞，左側與下方仍有殘存造血，符合 ALK 陽性未分化大細胞淋巴瘤骨髓侵犯（需 CD30/ALK 證實）。
features: Sheets of large atypical cells replacing most of the intertrabecular marrow space at center and right
Large cells with vesicular, irregular nuclei, some small nucleoli and moderate pale amphophilic to clear cytoplasm
Scattered admixed eosinophils and small clusters of erythroid precursors within the infiltrate
Residual normal hematopoiesis with maturing granulocytes and erythroid cells at the left and along the bottom
Two bony trabeculae; interspersed adipocytes; occasional megakaryocytes in residual marrow
60874.describe_en: Hematoxylin and eosin-stained bone marrow biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with extensive replacement by sheets of large atypical cells occupying most of the intertrabecular space. The neoplastic cells have enlarged vesicular, irregular nuclei, small nucleoli and moderate amphophilic to clear cytoplasm; hallmark cells with horseshoe-shaped nuclei cannot be reliably identified at this magnification. Scattered eosinophils and erythroid precursors are admixed, and residual trilineage hematopoiesis is present at the left and inferior aspects of the field. Findings are consistent with extensive marrow involvement by a large cell neoplasm, in keeping with ALK-positive anaplastic large cell lymphoma when confirmed by CD30 and ALK immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: cHL involvement features scattered Reed-Sternberg cells in a fibrotic polymorphous background rather than cohesive sheets of large cells, and is CD15+/PAX5 weak and ALK negative.
AML blasts are smaller with finer chromatin and are CD34/CD117/MPO positive, lacking strong uniform membranous/Golgi CD30 and ALK.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor (e.g., rhabdomyosarcoma, neuroblastoma)
ddx.vs: Metastatic tumors form cohesive nests with desmoplasia and are CD45 negative with lineage-specific markers (desmin/myogenin, PHOX2B).
DLBCL cells are CD20/PAX5 positive B cells, whereas ALCL cells are CD30 positive T/null cells, often with loss of pan-T markers and ALK expression.

60810.recognize_zh: TRAP 免疫染色在肝竇內成團的腫瘤細胞呈顆粒狀細胞質陽性，肝細胞核圓且大致不染（僅少量背景顆粒），竇內浸潤加上 TRAP 陽性支持毛細胞白血病。
features: Granular cytoplasmic TRAP staining in cells filling hepatic sinusoids
Anastomosing cords of positive cells between hepatocyte plates
Positive cells with oval nuclei and moderate cytoplasm
Hepatocytes largely negative with faint granular background staining
60810.describe_en: Tartrate-resistant acid phosphatase immunohistochemistry on liver shows strong granular cytoplasmic staining of lymphoid cells arranged in anastomosing cords within hepatic sinusoids. Hepatocytes are largely negative, with only faint granular background reactivity. The sinusoidal TRAP-positive infiltrate is consistent with hepatic involvement by hairy cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: Mast cells can be TRAP positive, but they are CD117/tryptase positive and form spindle-cell aggregates rather than CD20+ sinusoidal B cells.
Occasionally weak TRAP, but lacks CD25/annexin A1/CD103 and does not show strong diffuse TRAP with BRAF V600E.
TRAP usually weak or negative and annexin A1/CD25 negative.

60618.recognize_zh: 同一視野中有兩群紅血球：大部分為大小、血色正常的紅血球，另有一群淡染、低色素、形狀不規則或細長的小紅血球（dimorphic picture），在小球性貧血的女性要想到 X 染色體連鎖鐵粒母細胞貧血帶因者的萊昂化（lyonization）。
features: Dimorphic red cell population: majority normocytic normochromic red cells
Second population of pale, markedly hypochromic cells with thin rims, many small, irregular, elongated or fragmented
Anisocytosis and poikilocytosis confined largely to the hypochromic population
Platelets present and adequate in number; no leukocytes in this field
No basophilic stippling or Pappenheimer bodies are discernible at this resolution
60618.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a dimorphic erythrocyte population composed of normocytic normochromic red cells admixed with a distinct population of small, markedly hypochromic cells showing poikilocytosis, including elongated and irregular forms. Platelets are present in normal numbers. In a woman with microcytic anemia, a dual red cell population raises the possibility of skewed X-inactivation in a carrier of X-linked sideroblastic anemia (ALAS2), which should be confirmed with a bone marrow iron stain for ring sideroblasts and genetic testing. Findings are suggestive of X-linked sideroblastic anemia in a heterozygous female.

ddx.dx: Iron deficiency anemia after transfusion or iron therapy
ddx.vs: A post-transfusion or recovering iron-deficiency dimorphic picture is distinguished by history, low ferritin and absence of ring sideroblasts.
MDS-RS usually shows macrocytic red cells as the dominant population with other cytopenias and dysplasia, and SF3B1 mutation rather than ALAS2.
Thalassemia trait shows uniformly microcytic cells with target cells and a raised RBC count rather than two separate populations.
Combined deficiency gives macrocytes with hypersegmented neutrophils together with hypochromic microcytes.

exam.answer_en: Dimorphic red cell picture (normochromic plus hypochromic microcytic population) — suggestive of X-linked sideroblastic anemia in a heterozygous female
pearls_zh: 考法：考官問「這張抹片有幾群紅血球」並要求列出 dimorphic picture 的鑑別：輸血後、缺鐵治療中、sideroblastic anemia、B12/葉酸合併缺鐵。
XLSA 遺傳：ALAS2 突變（heme 合成第一步，需 pyridoxal phosphate 輔因子），男性為主；女性帶因者因 skewed X-inactivation 出現兩群紅血球，且可隨年齡加重而較晚發病。
必做檢查：骨髓鐵染色找 ring sideroblasts（Prussian blue）；鐵蛋白與運鐵蛋白飽和度（無輸血也可鐵過載）；ALAS2 基因檢測。
治療連結：部分 ALAS2 突變對 pyridoxine（vitamin B6）有反應，應先試用；鐵過載需 phlebotomy 或 chelation 處理。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為缺鐵性貧血（或其補鐵/輸血後）：缺鐵者 ferritin 低、骨髓無儲存鐵；XLSA 鐵指標正常或偏高、骨髓有 ring sideroblasts，女性帶因者呈持續性雙族群紅血球。

quiz.q: 女性病人抹片呈現正常色素與低色素兩群紅血球，若懷疑 X-linked sideroblastic anemia，致病基因與可先嘗試的治療為何？

60682.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中許多細胞核呈雙葉或摺疊、胞質含顆粒，乍看類似低顆粒型 APL（B、C），但 E 圖 FISH 顯示紅綠訊號分開、無融合訊號，F 圖為核型分析，提示形態像 APL 卻缺乏 PML::RARA，屬「誤導性」APL 形態。
features: Aspirate (A-C): increased immature myeloid cells with bilobed, folded, or reniform nuclei and granular to hypogranular cytoplasm, mimicking microgranular APL
Some cells with pale basophilic cytoplasm and possible fine granules; dotted arrows highlight cells/structures of interest (Auer rods not clearly resolved at this resolution)
Panel D: large blasts with fine chromatin, nucleoli, and fine azurophilic granules
FISH (E): separate red and green signals in metaphase and interphase nuclei without a fusion signal, i.e., no PML::RARA fusion evident
Karyotype (F): G-banded karyogram; the specific abnormality cannot be resolved at this image resolution
60682.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears (panels A-D) show a population of immature myeloid cells with bilobed or folded nuclei, fine chromatin, and variably granular cytoplasm, together with larger blasts containing fine azurophilic granules, a pattern resembling hypogranular acute promyelocytic leukemia. Dual-color FISH (panel E) shows separate red and green signals in both an interphase nucleus and a metaphase, without the yellow/fused signals expected for PML::RARA. A G-banded karyotype is shown (panel F), but the individual chromosomal changes are not legible at this resolution. The findings illustrate an AML with APL-like morphology that lacks PML::RARA, emphasizing that APL must be confirmed genetically rather than by morphology alone.

ddx.vs: Microgranular APL shows bilobed hypogranular cells and faggot cells but, by definition, harbors PML::RARA (or a RARA variant), which is absent here by FISH.
NPM1-mutated AML can show cup-like/folded nuclei and an HLA-DR-negative, CD34-negative phenotype mimicking APL, but lacks RARA rearrangement and shows cytoplasmic NPM1.
This entity has monocytic cells with granules and characteristic erythrophagocytosis, and a KAT6A rearrangement rather than RARA.
Promonocytes with folded nuclei mimic APL but are nonspecific esterase positive and CD14/CD64 positive, with weaker MPO and no faggot cells.

60746.recognize_zh: 周邊血淋巴球的細胞質含有粗大紫紅色顆粒，骨髓中可見細胞質塞滿粗大深紫色顆粒、呈斑點樣的巨噬細胞 (Buhot/Gasser-like cells)，這種跨系列的溶小體儲積顆粒提示黏多醣症第三型 (Sanfilippo)。
features: Panels A-B (PB, x100): lymphocytes with round nuclei and cytoplasmic coarse metachromatic purple granules/inclusions
Panel C (BM, x100): large histiocytes/plasma-like cells with abundant cytoplasm packed with coarse dark purple granules
Granules are discrete, dot-like and densely clustered, some surrounded by clear halos
Panel D (x50): aggregates of cells with clumped dark granular material in a marrow particle
No sea-blue or crumpled-tissue-paper cytoplasm is seen
60746.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows lymphocytes containing coarse metachromatic cytoplasmic inclusions. Bone marrow aspirate shows increased macrophages and other cells with abundant cytoplasm packed with coarse, dark purple, vacuole-associated granules, forming aggregates in marrow particles. Findings are consistent with a lysosomal storage disorder of the mucopolysaccharidosis type, in keeping with mucopolysaccharidosis type III; confirmation requires urinary glycosaminoglycan analysis and enzyme or genetic testing.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have fibrillary crumpled-tissue-paper cytoplasm without discrete coarse metachromatic granules, and blood lymphocytes lack inclusions.
Niemann-Pick cells show foamy, finely vacuolated lipid-laden cytoplasm (or sea-blue histiocytes) rather than coarse purple granules.
Toxic granulation is confined to neutrophils in infection, whereas mucopolysaccharidosis inclusions are present in lymphocytes and marrow macrophages constitutively.
Chédiak-Higashi shows few giant fused granules in granulocytes and lymphocytes rather than many coarse metachromatic dots.

60554.recognize_zh: 低倍血液抹片可見紅血球普遍排成長鏈狀的疊錢狀（rouleaux），提示血中有大量單株免疫球蛋白；視野中央僅一顆深藍色單核細胞，解析度不足以確認是否為漿細胞。
features: Low-power field dominated by prominent rouleaux formation with red cells in long branching chains
Single small round cell with intensely basophilic cytoplasm near the center; nuclear detail not resolvable
Faint bluish background staining can accompany increased serum protein
Scattered platelets; very few leukocytes in this field
Image resolution limits assessment of eccentric nucleus or perinuclear hof
60554.describe_en: Low-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows marked rouleaux formation, with red cells stacked in long, branching chains across the field, suggesting a high concentration of serum immunoglobulin. A single cell with deeply basophilic cytoplasm is present centrally, but the magnification and resolution do not allow confident identification as a plasma cell. Leukocytosis is not appreciable in this field. The rouleaux supports a paraproteinemia, and in the given clinical context the findings are suggestive of a plasma cell neoplasm such as plasma cell leukemia; higher-power review and a quantitative plasma cell count are required.

ddx.vs: Pseudo-rouleaux in thick areas disappears in the thin monolayer, whereas true rouleaux persists where red cells should lie separately.
Agglutinates form irregular three-dimensional clumps rather than linear coin-stack chains.
LPL can also produce rouleaux but circulating cells are mainly small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes rather than plasma cells.

60426.recognize_zh: 低倍（A、B）見結構完全被單一形態的大型細胞瀰漫取代，高倍（C）細胞核大、染色質細緻、偶見明顯核仁，並散布含吞噬碎片的組織球與凋亡小體（星空樣）；免疫染色顯示 B 細胞膜染色、CD10 陽性、Ki-67 極高。形態只能說是高惡性 B 細胞淋巴瘤，「三重打擊」必須靠 FISH 證實 MYC、BCL2、BCL6 重排。
features: Diffuse, sheet-like effacement of tissue by a monotonous lymphoid infiltrate at low power (A, B)
Large cells with vesicular to finely dispersed chromatin, scant cytoplasm and occasional prominent nucleoli (C)
Numerous apoptotic bodies, mitoses and scattered tingible-body macrophages imparting a focal starry-sky appearance (C)
Membranous B-cell marker staining (D, weaker/variable; E, strong diffuse membranous)
Very high Ki-67 proliferation index with nuclear staining in nearly all tumor cells (F)
60426.describe_en: Sections show diffuse effacement by sheets of monotonous atypical lymphoid cells. At high power, the cells are large, with vesicular to fine chromatin, scant cytoplasm and occasional prominent nucleoli, accompanied by frequent mitoses, apoptotic bodies and tingible-body macrophages. Immunohistochemistry shows membranous staining for CD20 (panel D, weaker and more variable in this field) and strong diffuse CD10 (panel E), and a Ki-67 proliferation index approaching 100% (F). The morphology and germinal center B-cell phenotype are those of a high-grade B-cell lymphoma; with FISH demonstrating MYC, BCL2 and BCL6 rearrangements, findings are consistent with high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements ('triple hit').

ddx.vs: Burkitt cells are medium-sized, uniform with squared-off cytoplasmic borders and multiple small nucleoli, BCL2-negative, and have isolated MYC::IG translocation without BCL2 rearrangement.
DLBCL NOS can look identical and have high Ki-67, so FISH for MYC with BCL2 (and BCL6) rearrangements is required for the distinction.
Lymphoblastic lymphoma has finer blastic chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli and expresses TdT/CD34, often with weak or absent CD20.
Blastoid MCL is CD5-positive and cyclin D1/SOX11-positive with CCND1 rearrangement, and typically CD10-negative.

60362.recognize_zh: G 帶核型圖中 7 號染色體只有一條（箭頭指出缺少的同源染色體），其餘常染色體成對、性染色體為 XY，即 45,XY,-7（monosomy 7），是骨髓衰竭／MDS 相關的高風險細胞遺傳異常。
features: G-banded karyogram of a male cell (X and Y present)
Only a single chromosome 7 is present; the arrow marks the missing homolog
All other autosomes are present in pairs without obvious structural rearrangement
Interpretation: 45,XY,-7 (monosomy 7) in this metaphase
60362.describe_en: This G-banded karyogram shows a male metaphase in which only one chromosome 7 is present, with the arrow indicating the position of the absent homolog. The remaining autosomes and the sex chromosomes (XY) appear numerically and structurally normal at this band resolution. The finding corresponds to 45,XY,-7. Monosomy 7 is a recurrent, adverse-risk abnormality in myelodysplastic syndromes and AML and, in a patient with marrow failure (e.g., aplastic anemia, Fanconi anemia or GATA2/SAMD9/SAMD9L germline predisposition), signals clonal evolution; it is considered MDS-defining cytogenetics even in the absence of definitive dysplasia.

ddx.vs: In del(7q) both chromosome 7 homologs are present but one has a truncated long arm, whereas here one entire chromosome 7 is missing.
Random loss in a single metaphase is non-clonal; a clonal monosomy requires the same loss in at least three metaphases or confirmation by FISH.
A derivative chromosome carrying 7p or 7q material would be present elsewhere in the karyogram; FISH with 7 centromere and 7q probes clarifies.

exam.answer_en: Monosomy 7 — G-banded karyogram 45,XY,-7 with one chromosome 7 absent; adverse clonal abnormality signaling MDS/clonal evolution in marrow failure
pearls_zh: 判讀：數染色體時 7 號只有一條、其他成對，寫作 45,XY,-7；國際命名規則中 clonal loss 需在至少 3 個 metaphase 出現同樣缺失，單一 metaphase 可能是製片造成的 random loss。
骨髓衰竭（aplastic anemia、Fanconi anemia）追蹤中出現 -7 代表 clonal evolution 往 MDS/AML 進展，預後差，常是考慮 allogeneic HSCT 的觸發點。
兒童/年輕人 MDS 合併 monosomy 7，要想到 germline predisposition：GATA2 deficiency（MonoMAC、單核球減少）、SAMD9/SAMD9L；選擇親屬捐贈者前要先驗 germline。
預後分級：-7 在 IPSS-R 屬 poor risk，在 AML（ELN 2022）屬 adverse risk；WHO 2016 將 -7/del(7q) 列為缺乏形態診斷時可作為 MDS 推定證據的異常。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 del(7q) 或 unbalanced translocation 如 der(1;7) 混淆；del(7q) 兩條 7 號仍在但一條長臂變短，der(1;7) 的 7 號物質藏在別條染色體上，可用 7 centromere/7q FISH 釐清。

quiz.q: 這張核型的正確 ISCN 描述為何？若病人是 15 歲合併單核球極少的 MDS，應考慮哪個 germline 基因？

60170.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中可見三個成熟單核球：核摺疊或呈腎形、染色質細緻、細胞質豐富灰藍並有少量空泡，旁邊僅一個嗜中性球，顯示單核球比例明顯增加，符合 CMML。
features: Three mature monocytes with folded, indented or reniform nuclei and fine lacy chromatin
Abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with irregular borders and occasional small vacuoles
Monocytes outnumber neutrophils in the field (single segmented neutrophil)
No blasts or promonocytes with nucleoli seen in this field
Red cells largely normocytic and normochromic
60170.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an increase in mature-appearing monocytes, with folded to reniform nuclei, fine chromatin and abundant gray-blue, focally vacuolated cytoplasm. A single segmented neutrophil is also present. Blasts and promonocytes are not identified in this field, and red cells are unremarkable. With the reported leukocytosis and absolute monocytosis, findings are consistent with chronic myelomonocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Promonocytes and monoblasts have delicately folded nuclei with visible nucleoli and more basophilic cytoplasm, and together exceed 20%.
Reactive monocytosis lacks dysplasia and clonality, and flow shows a normal classical-monocyte (CD14+CD16-) fraction below 94%.
JMML occurs in young children with RAS-pathway mutations and elevated HbF.

exam.answer_en: Chronic myelomonocytic leukemia, peripheral blood — absolute monocytosis of mature monocytes with folded/reniform nuclei and vacuolated gray-blue cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著核摺疊、胞質灰藍帶空泡的細胞問是 monocyte、promonocyte 或 blast；本圖為成熟 monocytes，重點是比例與絕對數增加。
WHO 5th 門檻：持續 monocytes ≥0.5×10⁹/L 且佔 WBC ≥10%，並需排除 BCR::ABL1、其他 MPN 與 tyrosine kinase 融合基因；blasts（含 promonocytes）<20%。
Flow 輔助：CMML 的 classical monocytes（CD14+/CD16−）比例常 >94%，反應性單核球增多則 intermediate/non-classical 較多。
WBC ≥13×10⁹/L 為 myeloproliferative CMML（MP-CMML），<13 為 myelodysplastic CMML（MD-CMML）；MP-CMML 常帶 RAS pathway 突變，預後較差。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤診為 reactive monocytosis（感染、發炎、恢復期）；反應性者持續時間短、無 clonal 證據，CMML 需持續 ≥3 個月並有 NGS（TET2、SRSF2、ASXL1）或核型異常、或發育不良支持。

quiz.q: 周邊血中這些摺疊核、灰藍胞質的細胞是什麼？WHO 5th 診斷 CMML 的單核球門檻為何？
quiz.a: Mature monocytes；持續 monocytes ≥0.5×10⁹/L 且 ≥10% WBC。

60042.recognize_zh: G 帶染色核型圖中，箭頭分別指向一條 8 號與一條 21 號染色體：8 號衍生染色體較短、21 號衍生染色體較長，代表 8q22 與 21q22 之間的平衡易位 t(8;21)，即 RUNX1::RUNX1T1。
features: G-banded karyotype with 23 chromosome pairs including two X chromosomes (female)
Arrow on one chromosome 8 showing a shortened long arm (der(8))
Arrow on one chromosome 21 showing an elongated long arm carrying translocated 8q material (der(21))
No other numeric or structural abnormality apparent in this metaphase, including no sex chromosome loss
Interpretation: 46,XX,t(8;21)(q22;q22)
60042.describe_en: G-banded karyotype of a single metaphase shows a female complement with a balanced reciprocal translocation between the long arms of chromosomes 8 and 21, indicated by arrows on the derivative 8 (shortened 8q) and derivative 21 (lengthened 21q). No additional numeric or structural abnormalities are evident in this metaphase. The findings correspond to 46,XX,t(8;21)(q22;q22.1), producing the RUNX1::RUNX1T1 fusion, which defines acute myeloid leukemia with t(8;21) regardless of blast count under WHO criteria.

ddx.dx: AML with inv(16) or t(16;16); CBFB::MYH11
ddx.vs: The other core-binding factor leukemia involves pericentric inversion of chromosome 16, whereas chromosomes 16 here appear normal and the rearrangement involves 8 and 21.

ddx.dx: t(3;21) RUNX1::MECOM in therapy-related myeloid neoplasm or CML blast phase
ddx.vs: This alternative RUNX1 translocation involves chromosome 3 rather than chromosome 8; FISH or RT-PCR confirms the partner.
Complex variants involve a third chromosome and may need RUNX1::RUNX1T1 FISH or RT-PCR, whereas this is a simple two-way translocation visible by banding.

exam.answer_en: AML with t(8;21)(q22;q22.1); RUNX1::RUNX1T1 — G-banded karyotype 46,XX,t(8;21) with shortened der(8) and elongated der(21)
pearls_zh: 讀圖：箭頭指的 8 號長臂變短、21 號長臂變長，為 8q22 與 21q22 的平衡互換；ISCN 寫法 46,XX,t(8;21)(q22;q22.1)。確認 clone 需至少兩個 metaphase 有相同結構異常。
分子：產生 RUNX1::RUNX1T1（舊稱 AML1-ETO），屬 core-binding factor AML；可用 FISH 或 RT-PCR 確認，並以 qPCR 追蹤 MRD。常見額外異常為性染色體缺失（-X/-Y）與 del(9q)。
形態/表型連結：母細胞有細長 Auer rods、鮭魚色顆粒與成熟顆粒球發育不良；flow 常見異常 CD19、PAX5、CD56 表現。
預後與分類：ELN 2022 屬 favorable risk；KIT 突變常見。WHO 5th 此類不設母細胞門檻，ICC 2022 則要求 ≥10%。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與另一種 CBF AML inv(16)/t(16;16) CBFB::MYH11 混淆，或誤把 21 號的變化看成 t(3;21)：本圖 16 號成對正常、異常僅涉及 8 與 21；inv(16) 需看 16 號染色體並常以 FISH 確認，形態伴異常嗜酸球。

quiz.q: 此核型的融合基因為何？ELN 2022 風險分類為何？

27082.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片由正常細胞密度、散在巨核細胞（A）逐步變為過度增生、巨核細胞增多且成群、形態不典型（B、C），網狀纖維染色顯示纖維增加；周邊血可見未成熟骨髓細胞與有核紅血球（leukoerythroblastic picture）——呈現 romiplostim 相關骨髓纖維化進展為骨髓增生性腫瘤的過程。
features: Panel A (H&E): roughly age-appropriate cellularity with scattered megakaryocytes and fat
Panels B–C (H&E): hypercellular marrow with increased, loosely clustered megakaryocytes showing variable size and hyperlobated/hyperchromatic nuclei
Insets (reticulin): increased reticulin fibers, more dense and intersecting in panel C
Panel C inset (low power): markedly hypercellular marrow core
Panel D (PB): circulating immature granulocytes and a nucleated red cell (leukoerythroblastic picture)
27082.describe_en: Sequential bone marrow trephine sections show progression from a marrow with preserved fat and scattered megakaryocytes (A) to a hypercellular marrow with increased, clustered megakaryocytes of variable size with hyperlobated and hyperchromatic nuclei (B, C). Reticulin stains (insets) demonstrate increasing reticulin fibrosis, becoming a dense intersecting network. The peripheral blood smear (D) shows immature granulocytes and a nucleated red cell, consistent with a leukoerythroblastic reaction. In a patient treated with romiplostim, the findings are consistent with thrombopoietin-receptor agonist-associated marrow fibrosis evolving into a myeloproliferative neoplasm (MPN, unclassifiable), with fibrosis grade requiring formal reticulin scoring.

ddx.vs: Drug-related fibrosis is usually low grade (MF-1) with normal megakaryocyte morphology and regresses after drug withdrawal, without persistent leukoerythroblastosis or clonal markers.
PMF shows dense clusters of bulbous 'cloud-like' megakaryocytes with JAK2/CALR/MPL driver mutations and no preceding TPO-agonist exposure.
ET has normocellular marrow with large hyperlobulated 'staghorn' megakaryocytes and no significant reticulin fibrosis or leukoerythroblastosis.
MDS with fibrosis shows small hypolobated micromegakaryocytes and multilineage dysplasia rather than large hyperlobated megakaryocytes.

23818.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中有小型、深染、細胞質極少的裸核樣細胞（紅箭頭，巨核細胞核碎片），以及帶有顆粒、邊緣不規則的大塊巨核細胞細胞質碎片（綠箭頭），背景有巨大血小板與血小板增多；這些碎片會被自動血球計數儀誤判為淋巴球或有核紅血球，需靠抹片辨認。
features: Small dense bare megakaryocytic nuclei with scant irregular cytoplasm (red arrows), mimicking lymphocytes or nucleated red cells
Large megakaryocytic cytoplasmic fragments with azurophilic granules and ragged budding edges (green arrows)
Increased platelets with giant and hypogranular forms
Scattered neutrophils and a myeloid precursor (left shift)
Red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis including occasional teardrop-like forms
23818.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows thrombocytosis with numerous giant platelets and circulating megakaryocytic fragments. Several small, densely staining nuclei with scant, irregular granular cytoplasm represent bare megakaryocytic nuclei, and larger granular cytoplasmic fragments with ragged edges represent megakaryocytic cytoplasm. Occasional neutrophils and an immature myeloid cell are present. These fragments can be misclassified by automated analyzers as lymphocytes, nucleated red cells or platelets clumps, distorting the differential and platelet count. Findings are consistent with circulating megakaryocytic fragments in a myeloproliferative neoplasm (polycythemia vera), highlighting the value of smear review.

ddx.vs: NRBCs have round, pyknotic nuclei with smooth, orange-pink hemoglobinized cytoplasm, not irregular granular cytoplasm with platelet budding.
Lymphocytes have a smooth rim of pale blue agranular cytoplasm, whereas megakaryocytic nuclei have wisps of granular cytoplasm with platelet-like edges.
Clumps are aggregates of discrete platelets without a nucleus, while megakaryocytic fragments are single continuous granular masses, sometimes with a nucleus.

ddx.dx: Micromegakaryocytes of myelodysplasia or AMKL blasts
ddx.vs: Micromegakaryocytes are intact small cells with a round nucleus and complete cytoplasm, and megakaryoblasts show fine chromatin with blebbed agranular cytoplasm.

19338.recognize_zh: A 圖的嗜中性球核只分兩葉、呈夾鼻眼鏡狀（pince-nez），染色質極度凝集，屬假性 Pelger-Huët 變化；B 圖為細胞質空泡化、吞入紅血球與細胞碎片的巨噬細胞（噬血現象），兩者合併指向噬血性淋巴組織球增生症（HLH）中的暫時性類 Pelger 變化。
features: Mature neutrophil with a bilobed pince-nez nucleus connected by a thin chromatin strand (panel A)
Very coarsely clumped, dense nuclear chromatin in the bilobed nucleus
Neutrophil cytoplasm with fine pink-lilac granules, not markedly hypogranular
Large macrophage with abundant foamy, vacuolated cytoplasm containing an engulfed red cell and purple nuclear debris (panel B)
Macrophage nucleus eccentric and oval with fine chromatin; background red cells
19338.describe_en: Panel A shows a mature neutrophil with a bilobed, pince-nez-shaped nucleus composed of two round lobes joined by a thin bridge and markedly condensed chromatin, with retained cytoplasmic granulation, consistent with a pseudo-Pelger-Huët (pelgeroid) change. Panel B shows a large macrophage with abundant vacuolated cytoplasm containing engulfed red cells and nuclear debris, consistent with hemophagocytosis. Hypolobation in this setting may be acquired and transient, and should be judged against the proportion of affected neutrophils, prior counts, and other lineage dysplasia. Findings are consistent with transient pelgeroid neutrophil change accompanying hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis, which requires correlation with HLH-2004 clinical and laboratory criteria.

ddx.vs: The inherited LBR-related anomaly affects most neutrophils persistently in an otherwise healthy person and family members, whereas this change is transient and disease-associated.
MDS-related pseudo-Pelger cells are usually hypogranular and accompanied by multilineage dysplasia, cytopenias, and clonal abnormalities that persist after the acute illness.
Mycophenolate, valproate, taxanes, or other drugs can produce identical hypolobated neutrophils, so medication history and resolution on withdrawal are needed to separate them.

16586.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中嗜酸性球明顯增多，部分呈顆粒減少或分葉異常；C 圖可見大型未成熟細胞，細胞質充滿紫紅色與暗紫色混合顆粒（箭頭），提示嗜酸性球前驅細胞或異常細胞增生，配合 FIP1L1-PDGFRA 融合基因診斷。
features: Panels A–B (PB, low power): increased eosinophils, some with abnormal lobation and uneven granule distribution
Panel C: several large immature granulated cells with round nuclei and cytoplasm densely packed with coarse purple-violet and orange-pink granules
Arrows highlight cells with deeply basophilic-staining granules obscuring the nucleus (immature eosinophils with basophilic granules vs mast cell/basophil-like cells)
Scattered smaller granulated cells and mature eosinophils in the background
Red cells largely normocytic; no blasts with clear agranular cytoplasm evident at this resolution
16586.describe_en: Peripheral blood smears (panels A–B) show eosinophilia with mature eosinophils, some of which display abnormal nuclear lobation and irregular granule distribution. Panel C, at higher magnification, contains numerous large immature granulated cells with round nuclei and cytoplasm filled with coarse orange-pink and purple-violet granules; the arrowed cells have dense, dark basophilic-staining granules. Resolution does not allow firm separation of immature eosinophils with pro-granules from basophils or atypical mast cells. Morphology is nonspecific for clonality; in the context of persistent eosinophilia, findings are consistent with a myeloid neoplasm with eosinophilia and FIP1L1::PDGFRA rearrangement, which requires FISH (CHIC2 deletion) or RT-PCR confirmation.

ddx.vs: Reactive eosinophils are mature and normally granulated without circulating immature eosinophilic precursors, and FIP1L1::PDGFRA is absent.
HES is a diagnosis of exclusion with no clonal cytogenetic/molecular abnormality and no excess blasts, whereas this entity is defined by the PDGFRA rearrangement.
SM shows multifocal aggregates of spindle CD25+ mast cells with KIT D816V and tryptase elevation, while PDGFRA-rearranged neoplasms have scattered mast cells without KIT D816V.
CML shows a left-shifted neutrophilic series with basophilia and myelocyte bulge and is BCR::ABL1 positive.

3914.recognize_zh: 富含細胞的骨髓抹片中散見數顆巨核細胞，體積比成熟巨核細胞小、核分葉少（單核或雙葉）、細胞質偏嗜鹼性且顆粒少，屬未成熟巨核細胞，提示血小板高度更新。
features: Several megakaryocytes smaller than fully mature forms, scattered in a hypercellular aspirate
Non-lobulated or bilobed nuclei with relatively high N:C ratio
Moderately condensed chromatin without the hyperlobation of mature forms
Scant to moderate grey-blue, basophilic cytoplasm with little granulation
Background of full-spectrum granulocytic and erythroid maturation with lymphocytes
3914.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular with trilineage hematopoiesis. Megakaryocytes are readily found and include several small immature forms with non-lobulated or bilobed nuclei and relatively scant basophilic, poorly granulated cytoplasm. Granulocytic and erythroid maturation appears orderly in this field, and no blast excess is apparent. Findings are consistent with increased immature megakaryocytes, as seen with high platelet turnover (e.g. immune thrombocytopenia); correlate with the platelet count and exclude megakaryocytic dysplasia.

ddx.vs: Dysplastic forms show separated round nuclear lobes or hypolobated micromegakaryocytes with mature granular cytoplasm, together with dysplasia in other lineages.
Megakaryoblasts are blast-sized cells with fine chromatin, nucleoli and cytoplasmic blebs, occurring in sheets rather than as scattered larger immature megakaryocytes.
Osteoblasts have an eccentric nucleus with a pale hof away from the nucleus and occur in clusters, lacking the lobulated megakaryocytic nucleus.

3466.recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 下成片細胞的核呈折疊、凹陷、有核溝（nuclear grooves）的咖啡豆狀，胞質豐富淡嗜酸性，間雜幾顆亮紅色嗜酸性球，這是蘭格漢斯細胞組織球增生症（LCH）細胞的典型核形態。
features: Sheets of medium-to-large cells with moderate to abundant pale eosinophilic, finely vacuolated cytoplasm
Oval to reniform nuclei with prominent longitudinal grooves, folds and indentations (coffee-bean appearance)
Fine chromatin with thin nuclear membranes and inconspicuous nucleoli
Scattered eosinophils with bright red granular cytoplasm
Interspersed clear spaces/cystic vacuoles, likely edema or processing artifact
3466.describe_en: High-power section shows sheets of medium-to-large cells with moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval to reniform nuclei displaying conspicuous grooves, folds and indentations, with fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. Scattered eosinophils are admixed, and there are interspersed clear spaces. Significant nuclear pleomorphism and brisk mitotic activity are not evident. Findings are consistent with Langerhans cell histiocytosis; confirmation with CD1a and langerin (CD207) immunostains, and BRAF V600E testing, is recommended.

ddx.vs: Langerhans cell sarcoma shows overtly malignant cytology with marked pleomorphism, prominent nucleoli and high mitotic activity despite a similar immunophenotype.
Rosai-Dorfman histiocytes have round nuclei without grooves, very abundant pale cytoplasm with emperipolesis, and are CD1a-negative.
Erdheim-Chester histiocytes are foamy, CD1a- and langerin-negative, and accompanied by Touton giant cells and fibrosis.
Interdigitating dendritic cells are S100-positive but CD1a- and langerin-negative, and lack the eosinophil-rich background.

exam.answer_en: Langerhans cell histiocytosis — sheets of cells with grooved, folded coffee-bean nuclei and pale eosinophilic cytoplasm with admixed eosinophils
pearls_zh: 考法：高倍圖，考官指有核溝的腫瘤細胞，問核形描述（grooved/folded, coffee-bean）與診斷，並要求說出確診 IHC。
必考 IHC：CD1a+、langerin（CD207）+、S100+；電顯可見 Birbeck granules（網球拍狀）。確診 LCH 需 CD1a 或 langerin 陽性。
分子：約半數有 BRAF V600E，其餘多為 MAP2K1 等 MAPK 路徑變異；WHO 5th 將 LCH 歸為骨髓系來源的組織球/樹突細胞腫瘤。可用 VE1 IHC 或 PCR 檢測 BRAF V600E。
臨床分型：單系統（常見骨骼溶骨性病灶 eosinophilic granuloma）vs 多系統；侵犯 risk organs（肝、脾、造血系統）預後較差；中樞可致尿崩症；成人肺 LCH 與吸菸強相關。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 Rosai-Dorfman disease：RDD 組織球核大而圓、泡狀、核仁明顯、無核溝，有 emperipolesis 且 CD1a−、langerin−；LCH 細胞核有溝、CD1a+ 且常伴大量嗜酸性球。

quiz.q: 圖中腫瘤細胞核的特徵性形態為何？確診此病最關鍵的兩個 IHC 是什麼？
quiz.a: 核溝/折疊的咖啡豆狀核；CD1a 與 langerin（CD207）。

2122.recognize_zh: 高倍淋巴結可見副皮質區被小到中型淋巴球擴張，夾雜許多明顯的高內皮小靜脈（high endothelial venules）與竇狀空隙，細胞多形但無成片大型異型細胞，這是 ALPS 副皮質區增生的樣貌。
features: Paracortical expansion by small to medium-sized lymphocytes with round to slightly irregular nuclei
Admixed intermediate cells with vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli (immunoblast-like)
Prominent high endothelial venules with plump endothelial cells
Patent sinus-like spaces with pale edematous stroma and scattered erythrocytes
Polymorphous infiltrate without sheets of large atypical cells or Reed-Sternberg cells
2122.describe_en: Lymph node section at high power shows a markedly expanded paracortex composed of a polymorphous population of small to medium-sized lymphocytes with admixed immunoblast-like cells. Numerous high endothelial venules and open sinus-like spaces are present. There are no sheets of large atypical cells and no Reed-Sternberg-like cells. In the appropriate clinical setting, the paracortical hyperplasia is consistent with autoimmune lymphoproliferative syndrome; confirmation requires immunophenotyping for expanded CD3+ TCRαβ+ CD4-/CD8- double-negative T cells and FAS pathway testing.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma / angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: PTCL and AITL show cytologic atypia, clear cells, and expanded follicular dendritic cell meshworks with clonal TCR rearrangement, whereas ALPS double-negative T cells are polyclonal.
Viral hyperplasia has more immunoblasts and lacks the expanded CD4-/CD8- TCRαβ+ population, so the two are separated by flow cytometry or immunohistochemistry rather than morphology.
Classic Hodgkin lymphoma contains CD30+/CD15+ Reed-Sternberg cells, which are not seen in this field.

1546.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的嗜中性球體積偏大、細胞核分成約 6–7 葉（hypersegmented neutrophil，≥6 葉即具診斷意義），背景紅血球有卵圓形巨紅血球與淚滴細胞，兩者合併就是惡性貧血等巨母細胞性貧血的血片特徵。
features: Enlarged neutrophil (arrow) with a hypersegmented nucleus of approximately six to seven lobes
Normal fine neutrophilic granules in the cytoplasm
Background red cells with anisopoikilocytosis including oval macrocytes, elongated forms, and teardrop cells
Scattered small red cell fragments
Single small platelet; no polychromasia evident
1546.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an enlarged neutrophil (arrow) with a hypersegmented nucleus containing approximately six to seven lobes. The background red cells show anisopoikilocytosis with oval macrocytes, elongated cells, teardrop forms, and small fragments, without evident polychromasia. No blasts are seen. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic anemia, such as pernicious anemia due to vitamin B12 deficiency.

ddx.vs: The hereditary form is a benign autosomal dominant trait with normal red cells and normal B12/folate, unlike the macro-ovalocytes and poikilocytes present here.

ddx.dx: Iron deficiency or uremia with hypersegmentation
ddx.vs: These can cause mild hypersegmentation but have microcytic or normocytic red cells rather than macro-ovalocytes.
Drug-induced hypersegmentation and macrocytosis are morphologically similar, so distinction depends on medication history and vitamin levels.

exam.answer_en: Megaloblastic anemia (pernicious anemia) — hypersegmented neutrophil (6–7 lobes) with macro-ovalocytes and teardrop cells
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指箭頭嗜中性球請你「數核葉」；hypersegmentation 常用標準為 ≥5% 嗜中性球有 5 葉，或出現任何一顆 ≥6 葉。
Hypersegmented neutrophil 是巨母細胞性貧血最早出現的周邊血變化之一，可早於 macrocytosis，治療後也最晚消失（約 1–2 週後才逐漸減少）。
Pernicious anemia 相關檢查：anti-intrinsic factor antibody（特異）、anti-parietal cell antibody（敏感）、gastrin 上升；常合併其他自體免疫病如 autoimmune thyroiditis、type 1 DM。
若只見 hypersegmentation 而紅血球正常，要想到遺傳性 hypersegmentation、iron deficiency、uremia 或藥物（hydroxyurea、methotrexate）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 hypersegmented neutrophil 與 G-CSF 或感染的左移/毒性變化混淆；後者核葉數不增加反而見帶狀核與 toxic granulation，且紅血球無 macro-ovalocytes。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指嗜中性球的核有幾葉？此發現加上背景紅血球變化，最支持什麼診斷？
quiz.a: 約 6–7 葉（hypersegmented neutrophil）；megaloblastic anemia（如 pernicious anemia）

1290.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中骨小樑旁有一大團緊密聚集的巨核細胞，大小不一、核深染且呈雲朵狀/球根狀（bulbous, hyperchromatic），並有裸核，是 MPN（尤其原發性骨髓纖維化型態）中典型的異型巨核細胞群聚。
features: Large, tight cluster of numerous megakaryocytes, including paratrabecular location
Marked variation in megakaryocyte size, from small to large forms
Hyperchromatic, irregularly folded, cloud-like or bulbous nuclei with high N:C ratio in many cells
Occasional naked (bare) megakaryocyte nuclei
Abundant pink cytoplasm; surrounding marrow with granulocytic cells and fat
Adjacent bone trabeculae without obvious osteosclerosis in this field
1290.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a large, dense cluster of megakaryocytes, partly abutting bony trabeculae. The megakaryocytes vary markedly in size and show atypical hyperchromatic, cloud-like to bulbous nuclei with increased N:C ratio and occasional bare nuclei. The surrounding marrow contains granulocytic precursors and fat; reticulin staining would be needed to assess fibrosis. Findings are consistent with atypical megakaryocytic clustering of a myeloproliferative neoplasm, most suggestive of primary myelofibrosis-type morphology.

ddx.vs: ET megakaryocytes are large to giant with hyperlobulated staghorn nuclei and are loosely clustered, not hyperchromatic cloud-like forms in tight clusters.
PV shows pleomorphic megakaryocytes with panmyelosis and erythroid hyperplasia, with fewer bulbous hyperchromatic nuclei.
MDS megakaryocytes are small hypolobated or with separated nuclear lobes and are usually not in large tight clusters.
Reactive megakaryocytes are increased but morphologically normal, dispersed rather than tightly clustered, and lack bulbous hyperchromatic nuclei.

exam.answer_en: Atypical megakaryocytic clustering of MPN (primary myelofibrosis pattern) — tight paratrabecular clusters of pleomorphic megakaryocytes with hyperchromatic cloud-like nuclei
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著這團巨核細胞問「這是什麼型態，最像哪一種 MPN？」重點是 dense cluster、大小不一、雲朵狀深染核、裸核、骨小樑旁分布。
Driver mutation：JAK2 V617F、CALR、MPL 三者互斥；三者皆陰性稱 triple-negative，預後較差；另可見 ASXL1、SRSF2 等高風險突變。
MPN 巨核細胞比較：ET 為大型、過度分葉「staghorn/鹿角狀」鬆散分布；PV 為多形但成熟；PMF 為異型、深染雲朵狀核並緻密群聚。
PMF 需做 reticulin stain 評估纖維化分級（MF-0 至 MF-3），prefibrotic PMF（MF-0/1）與 ET 的區分是常考重點，前者細胞量高、顆粒球增生。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 ET 混淆；ET 巨核細胞雖增加但為大而成熟的鹿角狀過度分葉核、少見緊密群聚與深染雲朵狀核，且骨髓細胞量不高；PMF 型巨核細胞異型性明顯。

quiz.q: 圖中緊密群聚、核深染呈雲朵狀的異型巨核細胞，最需要追加哪一種特殊染色以評估疾病分期？
quiz.a: Reticulin stain（評估骨髓纖維化分級）

1226.recognize_zh: 左上方的分節中性球細胞質有較粗的紫紅色毒性顆粒，細胞質邊緣有淡藍灰色的小斑塊（Döhle 小體）；但此倍率下 Döhle 小體不甚明顯。
features: Segmented neutrophils with increased, coarse purple cytoplasmic granules (toxic granulation)
Small pale blue-gray cytoplasmic patch near the periphery of a neutrophil, consistent with a Döhle body
Band neutrophils present
One monocyte with folded nucleus and gray cytoplasm
Red cells largely normocytic with occasional polychromatophilic cells; platelets present
1226.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows segmented and band neutrophils with coarse cytoplasmic granulation, and a small pale blue-gray peripheral cytoplasmic inclusion consistent with a Döhle body in at least one neutrophil. A monocyte is also present. Red cells are mostly normocytic with occasional polychromatophilic cells, and platelets are adequate in this field. At this magnification the Döhle body is subtle. Findings are consistent with reactive neutrophil changes (toxic granulation and Döhle bodies), as seen in infection, inflammation or G-CSF therapy.

ddx.vs: MYH9 inclusions are larger, more elongated and sharply defined, occur in most neutrophils and are accompanied by giant platelets and thrombocytopenia without toxic granulation.
Alder-Reilly granules are large dark granules present in all granulocytes and lymphocytes independent of infection, without Döhle bodies.
Chédiak-Higashi shows giant, irregular pink-gray lysosomal granules rather than small pale blue ER remnants.

exam.answer_en: Reactive neutrophil changes — toxic granulation with a subtle peripheral pale blue-gray Döhle body
pearls_zh: 考法：此倍率 Döhle body 不明顯，考官常問「這些中性球有哪些毒性變化？」要一併答出 toxic granulation、Döhle body（及 toxic vacuolation）。
Döhle body 為殘留的粗面內質網（rough ER / ribosomal RNA），呈淡藍灰色、位於胞質周邊，反映中性球加速成熟。
常見情境：細菌感染/敗血症、燒燙傷、懷孕、發炎、G-CSF 治療；毒性變化合併 toxic vacuolation 對菌血症較有意義。
May-Hegglin anomaly 屬 MYH9-related disorder：類 Döhle 包涵體（較大、較清楚、無毒性顆粒）+ 大血小板 + 血小板減少，可伴聽力喪失、腎病、白內障。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與 May-Hegglin 包涵體混淆；MYH9 包涵體較大、呈梭形、無毒性顆粒且合併巨大血小板與血小板減少，反應性 Döhle body 則細小淡染並伴毒性顆粒。

quiz.q: 圖中中性球胞質周邊淡藍灰色小斑塊的本質是什麼構造？
quiz.a: Döhle body，殘留的粗面內質網（ribosomal RNA）

1098.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片免疫組織化學染色中，大量細胞的細胞質呈棕色粗顆粒狀陽性，標示出豐富的骨髓單核球系細胞，符合JMML的骨髓單核球增生；確切標記名稱未標示。
features: Densely cellular marrow with numerous positive cells
Coarse granular to dot-like brown cytoplasmic staining pattern, typical of lysosomal/granule-associated markers
Positive cells include medium-sized cells with oval to folded nuclei and larger cells with abundant cytoplasm
Hematoxylin-counterstained negative nuclei interspersed, including some erythroid-appearing round nuclei
Specific antibody not indicated on the image
1098.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain on a bone marrow biopsy section shows a hypercellular marrow in which a large proportion of cells display coarse granular brown cytoplasmic positivity. The positive population includes medium-sized cells with oval to indented nuclei and larger cells with more abundant cytoplasm, consistent with expanded myelomonocytic elements. The specific antibody is not stated; the granular pattern is compatible with a myeloid/monocytic marker such as lysozyme, CD68, or MPO. In context, findings support myelomonocytic proliferation as seen in juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation
ddx.vs: AML requires at least 20% blasts/promonocytes with sheets of immature cells, whereas JMML shows maturing myelomonocytic cells with blasts below 20%.
Reactive states lack the RAS-pathway mutations, GM-CSF hypersensitivity, and elevated HbF characteristic of JMML.

ddx.dx: Juvenile xanthogranuloma or Langerhans cell histiocytosis in marrow
ddx.vs: Histiocytic lesions form discrete aggregates of CD163/CD1a-positive histiocytes rather than a diffuse maturing myelomonocytic expansion.

1098.stain: IHC: marker not stated (granular myeloid/monocytic pattern)

4234.recognize_zh: 三顆比小淋巴球稍大的單核細胞，圓到橢圓核、染色質細緻均勻、無明顯核仁，淡藍灰色胞質四周伸出細絲狀毛狀突起，是周邊血毛狀細胞的典型樣子。
features: Three medium-sized lymphoid cells with moderate N:C ratio
Round to oval nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Moderate pale blue-gray cytoplasm with fine, ragged hair-like projections around the circumference
Background red cells largely normocytic with occasional poikilocytes; platelets present
4234.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows three medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, and inconspicuous nucleoli. The cells have moderate amounts of pale blue-gray cytoplasm with fine, irregular hair-like projections. Red cells are largely unremarkable and platelets are present. Findings are consistent with hairy cells, suggestive of hairy cell leukemia; flow cytometry for CD11c, CD25, CD103 and CD123 is recommended.

ddx.vs: SMZL cells show short polar villi and more condensed chromatin and lack the CD25/CD103/CD123/annexin A1 profile of HCL.
HCL-v cells have prominent central nucleoli and are CD25 and annexin A1 negative, without BRAF V600E.
Reactive lymphocytes have abundant basophilic cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells and lack circumferential fine hairy projections.

exam.answer_en: Hairy cell leukemia — circulating medium-sized lymphoid cells with fine chromatin and circumferential hair-like cytoplasmic projections
pearls_zh: 考法：指三顆細胞問名稱。答 hairy cells：毛狀突起環繞整個細胞邊緣、染色質細緻、無明顯核仁。
Flow：CD11c、CD25、CD103、CD123 皆陽性（強 CD11c），CD5−、CD10−；IHC 以 annexin A1 最具特異性，另有 TRAP 陽性、cyclin D1 弱陽性。
分子：classic HCL 幾乎都有 BRAF V600E，可作診斷及標靶（vemurafenib）依據。
臨床：pancytopenia 合併 monocytopenia、脾臟腫大，骨髓因 reticulin fibrosis 常 dry tap；第一線為 purine analog（cladribine 或 pentostatin）± rituximab。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 splenic marginal zone lymphoma 的 villous lymphocytes：後者突起短且集中於一或兩極、染色質較粗，且 CD103/CD25/CD123/annexin A1 陰性、無 BRAF V600E。

quiz.q: 圖中細胞為何？最具診斷價值的突變為何？

1034.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有一團緊密相黏的中型單核細胞，染色質細緻、細胞質少且淡；此視野看不到吞噬血球的組織球，單憑此圖無法確認噬血現象，需搭配同案其他圖片。
features: Cohesive cluster of about 25 medium-sized mononuclear cells with nuclear molding
High N:C ratio with scant pale grey-blue cytoplasm
Round to oval nuclei with finely granular chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Scattered single mononuclear cells and red cells in the background
No histiocyte containing phagocytosed hematopoietic cells in this field
1034.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cohesive aggregate of medium-sized mononuclear cells with high N:C ratio, finely granular chromatin and scant pale cytoplasm, with focal nuclear molding.
